description.text:
Guidance Forward AB is looking for an AI Engineer / Data Scientist to work in the Gothenburg area, Sweden.


Work arrangement


Hybrid – our office is at Furumossen 43347 Partille. Depending on project requirements, work may take place at our office or at project locations anywhere in the Gothenburg area, with remote work opportunities.


Employment


Full-time, permanent employment (100%), subject to a genuine employment offer and agreed contract.


Main responsibilities


• Design, develop and implement AI and machine learning solutions.


• Build applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).


• Develop predictive models and data analytics solutions.


• Process and analyse datasets using Python and SQL.


• Develop and evaluate AI models and integrate them into business applications.


• Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers and business stakeholders.


• Support deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement of AI solutions.


Required qualifications


• Relevant degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering or similar.


• Professional experience in AI, machine learning or data science.


• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.


• Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Scikit-learn.


• Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs and AI model evaluation.


• Familiarity with Git, Agile development and software engineering practices.


• Good English communication skills.


Meritorious skills


• RAG, LangChain and vector databases.


• Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.


• Docker, CI/CD and MLOps.


• Data visualisation using Power BI, Tableau or Matplotlib.


How to apply


Send your CV and a short introduction to shyamkumar.ps@guidanceforward.se with the subject AI Engineer / Data Scientist – Gothenburg.


Application deadline: 30 November 2026.

description.text:
About us Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.
The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.
Watch our film 
About the role
As Quantitative Power Trader, you’ll own the intraday trading strategies at the heart of Ingrid’s BESS and renewable portfolio — building the arbitrage and proprietary strategies that turn market volatility into revenue. You’ll design, build, and refine the models and algorithms behind them, working hand-in-hand with our engineering team to get them into production, and staying close to the market through day-time trading shifts that keep you grounded in how your strategies actually perform.
Intraday is the focus, but never in isolation: you’ll bring a broader view of how we optimize BESS revenue across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets, so your strategies are tuned to the portfolio’s full revenue stack — not just one piece of it. 
What you'll do

Design, backtest, and continuously improve intraday trading algorithms — arbitrage and proprietary strategies — applying revenue-optimization thinking across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets so strategies fit the portfolio’s full revenue stack.


Execute trades with discipline and strong market feel while adhering to risk limits and governance frameworks.


Build and maintain quantitative models for price forecasting, degradation-adjusted cycling economics, and cross-market arbitrage (ancillary vs. wholesale vs. tolling).


Monitor the performance of Ingrid’s automated trading platform, pinpointing where live results deviate from the theoretical optimum and diagnosing why.


Collaborate closely with the engineering team to translate strategy logic into production code — this is not a hand-off-and-wait role.


Conduct scenario and stress-testing ahead of new market entries (new geographies or products).


Report on trading performance and risk exposure to leadership, including drawdown explanations and capacity utilisation metrics.


Take part in day-time trading shifts, with occasional weekend coverage to monitor live strategy performance.


Your work experience:

2–5 years of experience in a Data Scientist, Quantitative, or similar role within the energy sector, with direct exposure to European intraday power markets, either through trading or strategy development, is required; BESS experience is highly preferred.


Strong grasp of forecasting, optimization, and pricing across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets, with the intraday market as your core focus.


Familiarity with market design and regulatory frameworks, plus a sharp feel for power fundamentals, volatility, and market dynamics.


Strong programming capability (Python required; SQL and experience with data pipelines or model deployment a plus).


Comfortable working with large, complex datasets, with the analytical rigor to match.


Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or similar. 


Your personal skills
Beyond technical experience, we’re looking for someone with the right mindset and a genuine passion for renewable energy, including:

Ownership and self-leadership — taking initiative and full responsibility to drive and own your domain, and to bring concepts through to commercial execution.


Diligence and expertise — working persistently and thoroughly to become the subject matter expert.


Business acumen and commercial drive — understanding the commercial perspective behind every strategy.


Analytical and strategic thinking — precision in forecasting paired with big-picture judgment.


Communication and collaboration — clear with stakeholders, generous with knowledge across teams and disciplines.


Adaptability and agility — thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 


Why join us?
At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.
Next step
We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match.
We look forward to hearing from you!
/Team Ingrid

description.text:
We are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about leveraging data to drive commercial success in the gaming industry. In this role, you’ll focus on using analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimise game monetization strategies, support business development initiatives, and build scalable commercial tooling. You’ll partner with game designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to unlock data-driven insights that fuel our business growth and maximize player engagement.
Example of responsibilities 

Analyse game performance metrics and player data to identify business opportunities.


Provide insights and recommendations to optimise in-game economies, pricing models, and player engagement initiatives.


Collaborate with business development and product teams to develop data-driven monetization strategies.


Design, build, and maintain commercial tooling to empower commercial teams.


Build dashboards and reports to track business performance and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.


Utilize AI-assisted coding workflows to accelerate development.


We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind


Strong background in SQL


Experience in working with ETLs and data pipelines


Proficiency in Python for data modelling, analysis over large datasets, and script/tool building


Experience building tooling or interactive dashboards


Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools


Ability to communicate insights and strategies to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Experience or interest in games


Professional English communication skills. 


This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.
At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

description.text:
Would you like to play a key part in Toca Boca’s Data & Research engine? With over 60 million monthly active users and terabytes of daily data, as a Senior Data Scientist, you will play an integral role in understanding how kids and families engage with our play ecosystem, directly shaping fantastic, safe, and imaginative play experiences.

At Toca Boca, we don’t lock you into narrow corporate silos or endless maintenance tasks. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will enjoy broad end-to-end ownership across the entire product lifecycle—from exploratory data science, advanced modeling, and experimentation to product strategy and monetization dynamics.

You’ll join our Data & Analytics team while partnering seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner. Together, we blend big data behavioral telemetry with qualitative player research, working closely with cross-functional game teams to unlock the full value of our play ecosystem.

What you’ll be doing

Uncover Deep Player Insights: Analyze complex player datasets to understand behavioral patterns, feature engagement, and retention drivers across our games, informing overall product and commerce strategy.
Apply Advanced Statistical Methods: Apply statistical models, regression analysis, predictive segmentation, and experimental methods (A/B testing) to optimize product performance at scale.
Bridge Quantitative & Qualitative Insights: Partner seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner, connecting the "what" (big data trends) with the "why" (qualitative research) to deliver a 360-degree understanding of our players.
End-to-End Ownership & Influence: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous game product questions. Partner directly with PMs, Designers, and Engineers to translate complex datasets into clear, data-backed recommendations.
Innovate & Evolve Workflows: Continuously refine our analytics capabilities by leveraging modern data science workflows, predictive modeling, and AI tools to accelerate discovery and analysis.


What Success Looks Like

Trusted Co-pilot: You become a trusted analytical partner to game teams, shaping product decisions through rigorous data science, experimentation, and player empathy.
Broad Impact: You thrive with the freedom to influence multiple product areas—from core play loops and feature design to commerce and top-of-funnel engagement—without being pigeonholed.
Holistic Insights: You successfully bridge quantitative behavioral data with qualitative user research to create unified narratives that inspire game design.
Autonomy & Momentum: You help teams move quickly by surfacing key facts, reducing ambiguity, and solving open-ended problems that don't have predefined playbooks.


Is This You?

3+ years of experience (or equivalent senior-level impact) in user-focused Data Science or Advanced Product Analytics within Gaming, Mobile Apps, or Interactive Digital Products.
Empathy & Product Sense: Deep curiosity and intuition for player experience, engagement, and kids' digital environments.
SQL Mastery & Data Exploration: Outstanding SQL skills querying cloud data warehouses (experience with Google BigQuery and DBT is a huge plus).
Advanced DS Toolkit: Proficiency in Python (or R) for statistical modeling, machine learning, segmentation, and exploratory deep dives. Experience with BI tools like Tableau or Looker is a great plus!
Rigorous Statistical Foundation: Strong track record in experimentation lifecycle design, A/B test analysis, and hypothesis testing.
AI & Modern Workflows (Nice to have): Curiosity or Hands-on experience building, integrating, or utilizing AI/LLM tools within your data workflows or analytics stack.
Clear Storytelling & Autonomy: Skilled at translating complex quantitative and qualitative data into simple, compelling recommendations for non-technical partners. Thrives with high autonomy in fast-paced environments.


This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Lylli and Originator, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Toca Boca develops digital games that capture the power of play and that are filled with fun and silliness that kids around the world can instantly relate to. Since our first product launch in 2011, we have released 46 apps that have been downloaded more than 444 million times the world over, making us the No. 1 mobile-first kids brand in the App Store. Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.

  • Advanced DS Toolkit: Proficiency in Python (or R) for statistical modeling, machine learning, segmentation, and exploratory deep dives. Experience with BI tools like Tableau or Looker is a great plus!
  • Rigorous Statistical Foundation: Strong track record in experimentation lifecycle design, A/B test analysis, and hypothesis testing.
  • AI & Modern Workflows (Nice to have): Curiosity or Hands-on experience building, integrating, or utilizing AI/LLM tools within your data workflows or analytics stack.
  • Clear Storytelling & Autonomy: Skilled at translating complex quantitative and qualitative data into simple, compelling recommendations for non-technical partners. Thrives with high autonomy in fast-paced environments.

This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Lylli and Originator, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Toca Boca develops digital games that capture the power of play and that are filled with fun and silliness that kids around the world can instantly relate to. Since our first product launch in 2011, we have released 46 apps that have been downloaded more than 444 million times the world over, making us the No. 1 mobile-first kids brand in the App Store. Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.

description.text:
At Axis Communications we are passionate about creating a smarter and safer world! Are you excited about designing scalable data pipelines and enabling analytics and AI applications? We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Engineer to build and improve production data pipelines and data products for Global Operations. You'll work closely with our analytics team, process owners, and integration experts to make supply-chain data reliable and useful for reporting and analysis.
This is a specialist individual-contributor role. You'll own defined pipelines and data products from implementation through ongoing improvement, while collaborating with colleagues on platform and architectural decisions.

Who is your future team?
Operations Development is a cross-functional team of around 30 experts in Supply Chain, Project Management, Innovation, and System Management. You will specifically join the Operations Development Analytics team, a team of 8 highly skilled engineers focusing on BI and Analytics within Supply Chain. You will be reporting to the Data & Analytics Manager for Operations Development.
While ClickHouse, Qlik Sense and Power BI are our key data & analytics platforms, the team also develops advanced analytics solutions using machine learning, generative AI, and a broad range of modern technologies.

What you'll do as a Data Engineer?
As a data engineer, you will create value and enable business growth by bringing data from across Axis together to gather actionable insights. Data & Analytics is passionate about making data, analytics and insights easily findable and explainable for the many to enable better and faster decision-making.
Your focus will be to:
Develop and maintain data models and data products in ClickHouse and dbt. 
Build and support ETL/ELT pipelines from internal and external sources. 
Improve data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation for existing solutions. 
Investigate and resolve data and pipeline issues 
Work with analysts, process owners, and integration experts to turn defined business needs into reliable data solutions. 
Share knowledge and contribute to the team's engineering standards 
Ensure that data access, privacy, and governance requirements are built into our solutions. 
Contribute to technical decisions within the team, and help the team choose solutions that balance reliability, scalability, and business value. 
Stay current with new data engineering technologies and practices, applying them where they create clear business value. 

Who are you?
You are an analytical thinker who thrives in an innovative, ever-changing environment. You enjoy the challenge of building relationships across organizational borders and can support stakeholders to establish the best possible solutions. You aren't just interested in the "how" of the data, but the "why" of the business and you are genuinely curious about global supply chains and operational excellence. We're looking for someone with several years of practical experience building and supporting production data pipelines. You've worked with data models and transformations in a team environment and are comfortable taking responsibility for defined solutions.
What we are looking for:
Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering practices, including workflow orchestration, transformation frameworks, analytical databases, and containerized environments. Experience with Airflow, dbt, ClickHouse, and Kubernetes is valuable. 
Experience in designing, building, and operating production-grade data platforms and end-to-end pipelines. With a track record of taking technical ownership and improving existing systems. Typically, candidates have around 3-7 years of relevant experience. 
Strong skills in SQL and Python, data modelling, and data quality testing, including anomaly detection. 
Comfortable troubleshooting data issues and working with unclear or changing requirements. 
Commitment to high industry standards for collecting, managing, and transforming raw data into usable information. 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a team-oriented approach to ownership, cross-functional relationships, and knowledge sharing. 
Curiosity and adaptability-a proactive problem solver who enjoys learning, embraces change, and works well face-to-face in a dynamic global environment. 

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. 
Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.
Ready to Act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications. 
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon.
In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Rikard Herminge at +46 46 272 18 00

description.text:
Data Engineer till konsultbolag i Stockholm!
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning om inget annat anges
Just nu hjälper Black Sheep Recruitment ett konsultbolag att hitta deras nästa Data Engineer. Bolaget är grundat av erfarna entreprenörer och tekniska ledare, som bygger långsiktiga och högkvalitativa datalösningar med verkligt affärsvärde. Tech stacks som används är bland annat Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Apache Spark och dbt. Kulturen präglas av kunskapsdelning, samarbete och kontinuerligt lärande.
Black Sheep Recruitment
Ett nytt företag och rekryteringsbolag specialiserat på nischad rekrytering inom IT/Tech, med särskilt fokus på artificiell intelligens, Machine Learning och Data Engineers. Vi lägger stor vikt vid kandidatupplevelsen och ser till att alla som söker en roll hos oss blir väl bemötta och får återkoppling. Vi samarbetar dessutom med kunder vars tekniska miljö och kultur i mycket hög grad matchar dig, och därför lägger vi stor vikt vid matchningen mellan kandidater och kunder.
Vi arbetar med etisk rekrytering
Detta innebär att vi inte så stor uträckning som möjligt samarbetar med bolag som har positiv påverkan på människor och inte samarbetar med bolag inom branscher som har negativ påverkan på människor. Exempel på positiva branscher är: Cyber/IT-säkerhet, Life Science och Utbildning. Branscher vi inte samarbetar med är: Försvarsindustrin, Casino/Gambling och Tobak/Rökning.
Rollen
Du arbetar med kunduppdrag på plats hos kunden, där du designar, bygger och underhåller skalbara datapipelines och dataplattformar. Du äger affärsförståelsen och kundrelationen och översätter kundens behov till robusta tekniska lösningar. I arbetet säkerställer du hög datakvalitet, säkerhet och underhållbarhet, och använder AI-verktyg för att effektivisera utvecklingen utan att minska på kvaliteten.
Krav
Universitetsexamen inom som ingenjör, inom t.ex. datavetenskap eller liknande
Minst fem års erfarenhet som utvecklare, varav minst tre år inom Data Engineering.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL
Erfarenhet av att bygga datapipelines och arbeta med moderna dataplattformar
Intresse för AI och moderna kodverktyg, med förmåga att kritiskt granska AI-genererad kod.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska

Meriterande
Erfarenhet av Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark eller dbt.
Vem du är
Du är kvalitetsmedveten och förstår att datakvalitet är grunden för all analys och AI. Du är tekniskt nyfiken, samarbetsinriktad och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap. Samtidigt drivs du av lärande och att bli bättre på det du gör.
Bolaget erbjuder
Möjlighet att forma din roll och påverka hur konsultverksamhet utvecklas
Moderna projekt med fokus på långsiktiga och hållbara lösningar
En stabil miljö med erfarna grundare
Konkurrenskraftig lön, pension och förmåner
En stöttande och människocentrerad arbetskultur

Rekryteringsprocessen
Första samtal med rekryterare
Intervju hos Black Sheep Recruitment
Första Intervju hos kund
Andra Intervju hos kund
Referenstagning
Företaget har kontor i centrala Stockholm.
Lönespann: 50-70.000SEK / månad beroende på erfarenhet och bakgrund.
Skicka din ansökan så snart som möjligt, tillsättningen är ASAP. Vår ambition är att ge återkoppling inom 3 veckor.
Vi kan i nuläget inte hjälpa till med flytt eller arbetstillstånd/visum för Sverige.

description.text:
Vi utmanar de traditionella konsultbolagen och vi kan med stolthet säga att Castra är konsultbranschens mest utvecklande arbetsplats där allt är möjligt. Känns det här som företaget för dig så läs gärna vidare.
Är du en erfaren Data Engineer som vill bygga datalösningar som gör det enklare för verksamheten att använda sin data? Trivs du med att arbeta praktiskt med allt från dataintegration och pipelines till datamodellering och kvalitet? Då kan det här vara en roll för dig.
Vi på Castra söker nu en senior Data Engineer med huvudsaklig erfarenhet av Microsofts dataplattformar. Du får arbeta med att bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar som samlar in, bearbetar och tillgängliggör data för analys och rapportering.
Om uppdraget
Du arbetar nära utvecklare, analytiker och verksamheten för att förstå vilken data som behövs och hur den ska kunna användas. Du är med från design och utveckling till driftsättning och förvaltning, med fokus på att dataflödena är tillförlitliga och lätta att följa upp.
I uppdraget ingår att:

Bygga och underhålla datapipelines som hämtar och bearbetar data från olika källsystem.


Utveckla datamodeller och strukturera data för analys och rapportering.


Bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar i Microsoftmiljö, exempelvis i Azure eller Microsoft Fabric.


Följa upp datakvalitet, övervaka dataflöden och felsöka när inläsningar eller bearbetningar går fel.


Bidra till tekniska vägval och förbättra hur datalösningarna testas, driftsätts och förvaltas.


Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som är trygg i det praktiska arbetet som Data Engineer och kan ta ansvar för ett dataflöde hela vägen från källsystem till färdig datamodell. Du trivs med att samarbeta med både tekniska team och de personer som använder datan i sitt arbete.
För att vara aktuell för rollen behöver du ha:

Minst 5 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer.


Erfarenhet av att bygga och driftsätta datalösningar i Microsoftmiljö, exempelvis med Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory eller Azure Synapse Analytics.


Goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av datamodellering.


Erfarenhet av att bygga datapipelines för inläsning, integration och transformering av data.


Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datakvalitet och felsöka dataflöden i produktion.


Det är extra meriterande om du även har:

Erfarenhet av Python eller PySpark.


Erfarenhet av Azure Databricks, datalager eller lakehouse-lösningar.


Erfarenhet av att tillgängliggöra data för Power BI.


Erfarenhet av versionshantering och automatiserad driftsättning, exempelvis med Azure DevOps.


Placering
Du utgår från din ort. Beroende på uppdrag kan arbete på plats i Stockholm eller på närliggande orter förekomma.
Varför ska du välja oss?
Här tror vi på frihet, möjligheter och medbestämmande. Att du som medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att utvecklas och forma ditt arbete utefter dina intressen och prioriteringar i livet. Att alla får vara med och forma och påverka bolaget genom delägarskap, advisory board och projektgrupper. Att det är viktigt att ha ett sammanhang, känna tillhörighet och att man har kollegor som stöttar, utvecklar och tror på en.
Om Castra 
Castra är en entreprenörsdriven konsultgrupp inom IT, management och systemutveckling. Bolaget ägs gemensamt av medarbetarna och tillsammans bygger vi det företag vi själva vill jobba på.
Vår vision är att vi ska vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för konsulter. Att vi blivit certifierade av Great Place to Work® fem år i rad är ett bevis på våra höga mål kring företagskultur. Våra tankar om delaktighet, påverkansmöjligheter och respekt för individens egna val och möjligheter fungerar.
Företaget har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro och Jönköping. Mer information om Castra-koncernen hittar du på vår hemsida www.castra.se.
Har vi lyckats väcka din nyfikenhet? Sök direkt via länken eller kontakta emma.emsjo@castra.se

Vi på Castra söker nu en senior Data Engineer med huvudsaklig erfarenhet av Microsofts dataplattformar. Du får arbeta med att bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar som samlar in, bearbetar och tillgängliggör data för analys och rapportering.
Om uppdraget
Du arbetar nära utvecklare, analytiker och verksamheten för att förstå vilken data som behövs och hur den ska kunna användas. Du är med från design och utveckling till driftsättning och förvaltning, med fokus på att dataflödena är tillförlitliga och lätta att följa upp.
I uppdraget ingår att:

Bygga och underhålla datapipelines som hämtar och bearbetar data från olika källsystem.


Utveckla datamodeller och strukturera data för analys och rapportering.


Bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar i Microsoftmiljö, exempelvis i Azure eller Microsoft Fabric.


Följa upp datakvalitet, övervaka dataflöden och felsöka när inläsningar eller bearbetningar går fel.


Bidra till tekniska vägval och förbättra hur datalösningarna testas, driftsätts och förvaltas.


Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som är trygg i det praktiska arbetet som Data Engineer och kan ta ansvar för ett dataflöde hela vägen från källsystem till färdig datamodell. Du trivs med att samarbeta med både tekniska team och de personer som använder datan i sitt arbete.
För att vara aktuell för rollen behöver du ha:

Minst 5 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer.


Erfarenhet av att bygga och driftsätta datalösningar i Microsoftmiljö, exempelvis med Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory eller Azure Synapse Analytics.


Goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av datamodellering.


Erfarenhet av att bygga datapipelines för inläsning, integration och transformering av data.


Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datakvalitet och felsöka dataflöden i produktion.


Det är extra meriterande om du även har:

Erfarenhet av Python eller PySpark.


Erfarenhet av Azure Databricks, datalager eller lakehouse-lösningar.


Erfarenhet av att tillgängliggöra data för Power BI.


Erfarenhet av versionshantering och automatiserad driftsättning, exempelvis med Azure DevOps.


Placering
Du utgår från din ort. Beroende på uppdrag kan arbete på plats i Stockholm eller på närliggande orter förekomma.
Varför ska du välja oss?
Här tror vi på frihet, möjligheter och medbestämmande. Att du som medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att utvecklas och forma ditt arbete utefter dina intressen och prioriteringar i livet. Att alla får vara med och forma och påverka bolaget genom delägarskap, advisory board och projektgrupper. Att det är viktigt att ha ett sammanhang, känna tillhörighet och att man har kollegor som stöttar, utvecklar och tror på en.
Om Castra 
Castra är en entreprenörsdriven konsultgrupp inom IT, management och systemutveckling. Bolaget ägs gemensamt av medarbetarna och tillsammans bygger vi det företag vi själva vill jobba på.
Vår vision är att vi ska vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för konsulter. Att vi blivit certifierade av Great Place to Work® fem år i rad är ett bevis på våra höga mål kring företagskultur. Våra tankar om delaktighet, påverkansmöjligheter och respekt för individens egna val och möjligheter fungerar.
Företaget har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro och Jönköping. Mer information om Castra-koncernen hittar du på vår hemsida www.castra.se.
Har vi lyckats väcka din nyfikenhet? Sök direkt via länken eller kontakta emma.emsjo@castra.se

description.text:
What makes Cognizant a unique place to work? The combination of rapid growth and an international and innovative environment! This is creating a lot of opportunities for people like YOU — people with an entrepreneurial spirit who want to make a difference in this world. At Cognizant, together with your colleagues from all around the world, you will collaborate on creating solutions for the world's leading companies and help them become more flexible, more innovative and successful.


The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing data pipelines using Snowflake and IDMC. Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows and data pipelines using Snowflake and IDMC to process large datasets efficiently. Design data models, create and maintain views, stored procedures, and other database objects in Snowflake, optimize data storage, and ensure scalability in Snowflake. Implement data governance, access controls, and encryption to protect sensitive information.


Key Responsibilities:
Analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate data from Teradata to Snowflake.
Optimize migration processes ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance.
Create and manage Snowflake objects (tables, views, schemas, stages, procedures).
Implement partitioning, clustering, and performance tuning strategies.
Implement and manage Snowflake features such as Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, and Time Travel
Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and stored procedures in Snowflake SQL
Monitor and tune Snowflake performance, including warehouse sizing and query optimization and ensure efficient resource utilization and cost optimization.
Manage external stages, storage integrations, data security, access controls, and role-based permissions in Snowflake
Automate data ingestion from various sources using Snowflake connectors and external stages using different file format, code pages, and any integration with Saas tools (e.g. dbt cloud, Fivetran, Databricks etc).
Rewrite and optimize Teradata SQL scripts, macros, and stored procedures for Snowflake compatibility.
Develop reusable scripts for automation of migration tasks (Python, Shell etc.).
Conduct data reconciliation between Teradata and Snowflake post-migration.
Work closely with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements
Document migration processes, best practices, and technical solutions.



Technical Skills:
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake cloud data warehouse.
Knowledge of Snowflake features: Time Travel, Cloning, Micro-partitions, Streams & Tasks.
Hands on experience in Snowflake features like external stages, Snowpipe, storage integration, File Formats, RBAC etc
Strong experience with SQL and various database technologies (Oracle, Teradata SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.).
Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices for data pipelines and workflows.
Experience in data engineering or database development, particularly with data migrations.
Experience in different batch processing and data loading/transformation strategies.
Proficiency in scripting for automating regular or repeating task (python, shell scripting etc).
Understanding of Teradata architecture, SQL, and utilities (BTEQ, FastLoad, MultiLoad, TPT).
Experience in analysing and converting Teradata-specific functions to Snowflake equivalents.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Snowflake SnowPro Certification is a plus
Experience in banking and financial services will be preferred.



The Cognizant community:
We are a high caliber team who appreciate and support one another. Our people uphold an energetic, collaborative and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
Cognizant is a global community with more than 300,000 associates around the world.
We don’t just dream of a better way – we make it happen.
We take care of our people, clients, company, communities and climate by doing what’s right.
We foster an innovative environment where you can build the career path that’s right for you.



About us:
Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. Our unique industry-based, consultative approach helps clients envision, build, and run more innovative and efficient businesses. Headquartered in the U.S., Cognizant (a member of the NASDAQ-100 and one of Forbes World’s Best Employers 2025) is consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world. Learn how Cognizant helps clients lead with digital at www.cognizant.com
Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. Your application and candidacy will not be considered based on race, color, sex, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
Disclaimer: 
Compensation information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.
Applicants may be required to attend interviews in person or by video conference. In addition, candidates may be required to present their current state or government issued ID during each interview.

description.text:
At Axis Communications we are passionate about creating a smarter and safer world! Are you excited about designing scalable data pipelines and enabling analytics and AI applications? We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Engineer to build and improve production data pipelines and data products for Global Operations. You'll work closely with our analytics team, process owners, and integration experts to make supply-chain data reliable and useful for reporting and analysis.
This is a specialist individual-contributor role. You'll own defined pipelines and data products from implementation through ongoing improvement, while collaborating with colleagues on platform and architectural decisions.

Who is your future team?
Operations Development is a cross-functional team of around 30 experts in Supply Chain, Project Management, Innovation, and System Management. You will specifically join the Operations Development Analytics team, a team of 8 highly skilled engineers focusing on BI and Analytics within Supply Chain. You will be reporting to the Data & Analytics Manager for Operations Development.
While ClickHouse, Qlik Sense and Power BI are our key data & analytics platforms, the team also develops advanced analytics solutions using machine learning, generative AI, and a broad range of modern technologies.

What you'll do as a Data Engineer?
As a data engineer, you will create value and enable business growth by bringing data from across Axis together to gather actionable insights. Data & Analytics is passionate about making data, analytics and insights easily findable and explainable for the many to enable better and faster decision-making.
Your focus will be to:
Develop and maintain data models and data products in ClickHouse and dbt. 
Build and support ETL/ELT pipelines from internal and external sources. 
Improve data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation for existing solutions. 
Investigate and resolve data and pipeline issues 
Work with analysts, process owners, and integration experts to turn defined business needs into reliable data solutions. 
Share knowledge and contribute to the team's engineering standards 
Ensure that data access, privacy, and governance requirements are built into our solutions. 
Contribute to technical decisions within the team, and help the team choose solutions that balance reliability, scalability, and business value. 
Stay current with new data engineering technologies and practices, applying them where they create clear business value. 

Who are you?
You are an analytical thinker who thrives in an innovative, ever-changing environment. You enjoy the challenge of building relationships across organizational borders and can support stakeholders to establish the best possible solutions. You aren't just interested in the "how" of the data, but the "why" of the business and you are genuinely curious about global supply chains and operational excellence. We're looking for someone with several years of practical experience building and supporting production data pipelines. You've worked with data models and transformations in a team environment and are comfortable taking responsibility for defined solutions.
What we are looking for:
Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering practices, including workflow orchestration, transformation frameworks, analytical databases, and containerized environments. Experience with Airflow, dbt, ClickHouse, and Kubernetes is valuable. 
Experience in designing, building, and operating production-grade data platforms and end-to-end pipelines. With a track record of taking technical ownership and improving existing systems. Typically, candidates have around 3-7 years of relevant experience. 
Strong skills in SQL and Python, data modelling, and data quality testing, including anomaly detection. 
Comfortable troubleshooting data issues and working with unclear or changing requirements. 
Commitment to high industry standards for collecting, managing, and transforming raw data into usable information. 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a team-oriented approach to ownership, cross-functional relationships, and knowledge sharing. 
Curiosity and adaptability-a proactive problem solver who enjoys learning, embraces change, and works well face-to-face in a dynamic global environment. 

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. 
Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.
Ready to Act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications. 
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon.
In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Rikard Herminge at +46 46 272 18 00

description.text:
What makes Cognizant a unique place to work? The combination of rapid growth and an international and innovative environment! This is creating a lot of opportunities for people like YOU — people with an entrepreneurial spirit who want to make a difference in this world. At Cognizant, together with your colleagues from all around the world, you will collaborate on creating solutions for the world's leading companies and help them become more flexible, more innovative and successful.
Are you an experienced data engineer who enjoys building reliable data pipelines, integrations and APIs? As a Data Engineer at Cognizant, you will design and run ETL pipelines and integrations, support the adoption of modern cloud data platforms, and mentor the developers around you.


Key Responsibilities
Design and maintain ETL pipelines and data integrations using MuleSoft or similar iPaaS platforms.
Hands-on work with Snowflake and dbt, supporting the adoption of cloud data platforms.
Build REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven integrations (JMS, Anypoint MQ).



Requirements
8–10+ years in data integration or data engineering.
Strong ETL, data modeling and SQL skills (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
Hands-on experience with MuleSoft (Anypoint Platform, DataWeave) and API security (OAuth2, TLS).
Experience with Git, CI/CD and Agile/Scrum.



Nice to Have
Azure, Java, C#/.NET, or Python experience.
MuleSoft certifications.
Swedish language skills.



About Cognizant
Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is an AI Builder and technology services provider, bridging the gap between AI investment and enterprise value by building full-stack AI solutions for our clients. Our deep industry, process and engineering expertise enables us to build an organization's unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, drive tangible outcomes and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. See how at cognizant.ai or @cognizan

Nice to Have

  • Azure, Java, C#/.NET, or Python experience.
  • MuleSoft certifications.
  • Swedish language skills.

Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is an AI Builder and technology services provider, bridging the gap between AI investment and enterprise value by building full-stack AI solutions for our clients. Our deep industry, process and engineering expertise enables us to build an organization's unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, drive tangible outcomes and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. See how at cognizant.ai or @cognizan

31751107.headline: Data Engineer inom Microsoft Fabric och Data & AI

description.text:
Vår kund bygger framtidens dataplattformar. Här får du arbeta med den absolut senaste tekniken i Microsoft Fabric och driva innovativa projekt tillsammans med ett högkompetent team.
Om tjänsten
Som Data  fokuserar du på att skapa värde genom moderna dataarkitekturer i Microsoft Fabric. Du arbetar i avancerade miljöer nära både kunder och specialister för att bygga robusta lösningar som möjliggör datadrivna beslut. Tillsammans med BI-utvecklare och arkitekter formar du framtidens dataplattformar.
Du erbjuds en plats i ett högkompetent team där du arbetar med den senaste tekniken och spännande kunduppdrag. Du får stora möjligheter till kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning samt chansen att påverka tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt i en miljö där egna initiativ uppmuntras.
Arbetsuppgifter
Rollen innebär tekniskt ansvar för att bygga och underhålla moderna dataplattformar med fokus på Microsofts ekosystem, från rådata till färdiga analysunderlag.
Utveckla och vidareutveckla datalösningar i Microsoft Fabric  
Bygga och optimera datapipelines, Lakehouses och Dataflow Gen2  
Integrera olika datakällor och utveckla effektiva dataflöden  
Arbeta med Spark, SQL, DAX, notebooks och ETL-flöden  
Utveckla end-to-end-lösningar från datainsamling till analys och rapportering  
Delta i arkitektur- och designbeslut för dataplattformar  
Samarbeta med BI-utvecklare, analytiker och lösningsarkitekter

Vi söker dig som
Minst tre års erfarenhet av Data engineering eller utveckling av dataplattformar
Avancerad kunskap inom Microsoft Azure Data Platform, inklusive Databricks (PySpark) och ADLS
God förståelse för Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics och Power BI
Starka utvecklingsfärdigheter inom SQL och Python
Erfarenhet av att utveckla enterprise ETL/ELT-pipelines samt datamodellering
Erfarenhet av CI/CD, Git, DevOps samt Infrastructure as Code
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har
Certifieringar såsom DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), Azure Data Engineer eller Power BI Analyst
Erfarenhet av ERP-integrationer, till exempel Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O eller SAP S/4HANA
Kunskap inom strömmande teknologier och händelsestyrda arkitekturer
Erfarenhet av Docker, Kubernetes eller molnbaserade applikationsarkitekturer

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:
Hjälpsam
Målmedveten
Ansvarstagande
Intellektuellt nyfiken

Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

31746310.headline: Data Engineer L4 – Senior Data Engineer

description.text:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer for a consultancy assignment with a leading international company in Stockholm. The assignment is expected to start ASAP.
About the Client 
Our client is a leading global home appliance company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. With over 100 years of history and operations in around 120 markets, the company has a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and digital transformation.
Overview
We are seeking a highly autonomous, product-focused Senior Data Engineer to help accelerate the evolution of our modern, AI-ready data platform. This role is for engineers who leverage modern tooling, AI-assisted development, and strong engineering judgment to deliver outcomes quickly and independently. We are not looking for individuals who simply execute tickets. We are looking for engineers who can take ownership of ambiguous problems, challenge existing assumptions, and drive meaningful improvements across the platform.
 
Our Technology Stack
Candidates should be comfortable operating within a modern Azure-based data platform, including:
Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Apache Airflow
Databricks
dbt Cloud
Git-based development workflows
CI/CD practices
Data quality and observability tooling

What We´re Looking For
Product & Customer Focus
Strong customer-centric mindset with the ability to understand business needs and translate them into scalable data products.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders, product managers, analysts, and engineers.
Ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.
Comfort working in ambiguous environments and defining solutions rather than waiting for detailed requirements.
Agentic Engineering Mindset
We are specifically looking for engineers who embrace AI-enabled software development.

Candidates should:
Actively leverage modern AI development tools and coding assistants to increase personal productivity and accelerate delivery.
Be comfortable adopting emerging engineering workflows and AI harnesses (e.g., OpenCode, Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools).
Demonstrate a mindset focused on outcomes, iteration, and continuous improvement.
Use AI as a force multiplier while maintaining strong engineering judgment and accountability.

Technical Excellence
Deep experience building and operating data platforms using Databricks, dbt Cloud, Airflow, ADF, and Azure Data Lake.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture patterns.
Experience designing scalable ELT pipelines and data products.
Hands-on experience with data quality frameworks, testing strategies, observability, lineage, and governance.
Understanding of what is required to build and operate an AI-ready data platform.

What Success Looks Like
The ideal candidate:
Requires minimal direction and oversight.
Can take a loosely defined problem and rapidly deliver incremental value.
Moves from idea to implementation in hours or days, not weeks.
Consistently improves systems, processes, and developer experience.
Makes pragmatic, high-quality decisions when trade-offs are required.
Takes end-to-end ownership from discovery through implementation and operationalization.
Leaves every area of ownership better than they found it.


We Are Not Looking For
Engineers who primarily execute predefined tasks.
Candidates who require detailed specifications before they can begin delivering value.
Classified as InternalIndividuals whose experience centers solely on building pipelines without demonstrating
ownership, product thinking, or business impact.
Engineers who are hesitant to adopt AI-assisted development workflows.

Ideal Candidate Summary
We´re looking for a high-leverage engineer who combines:
Strong Databricks and modern data stack experience.
Product thinking and customer obsession.
Agentic Engineering practices and AI-enabled delivery.
End-to-end ownership.
Excellent judgment and decision-making.

Interested?
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please get in touch and share your CV in English.
We look forward to hearing from you!

description.text:
Jobbeskrivning
We’re looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines, develop scalable backend APIs, and improve the data solutions used across the team. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of trust, where you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work and drive improvements.
The role requires working on-site at our client’s office in Malmö three days per week.
 
Baskunskaper
What you’ll doBuild and maintain data pipelines using Spark and Flink.
Develop and improve data solutions used across the team.
Build scalable backend APIs that make data accessible.
Provide technical support to colleagues on data engineering topics.
Drive initiatives and contribute to technical improvements.
Who you are
We place great emphasis on personal qualities. You enjoy taking responsibility for your work and are comfortable working independently. You also enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, and supporting your colleagues.
You approach challenges with curiosity and creativity, use your analytical skills to find solutions, and communicate your reasoning clearly and confidently when discussing technical decisions.

Strong programming skills, including Python and either Java or Scala.
Solid backend development experience, for example with Scala Play or an equivalent framework.
A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. A master’s degree is a strong advantage.
Excellent written and spoken English.

 
Personliga färdigheter, egenskaper, erfarenhet
It’s an advantage if you have
Experience with Spark, Flink, or other big data tools.
Exposure to Iceberg, microservices running on Kubernetes, Snowflake, Kafka, or Akka.
Experience with visualization tools such as Grafana.
An interest in or hands-on experience with machine learning.

description.text:
Who you are 
You see yourself helping us develop products with data. You work agile, within cross-functional teams to keep IKEA leading in an exciting and fast moving environment. 
Our diverse and global team within Data & Analytics is growing and we would love to talk with you if you recognize yourself in some of the following: 
· Excited about IKEA’s core values and vision of creating a better everyday life for the many people. 
· A team player who promotes informed decision-making based on data and builds cross-functional relationships with peers. 
· Considers data to be the starting point for solving (almost) any business problem. 
· Has a background in analytics, computer science, engineering, or equivalent (at least MS or equivalent) 
· Good knowledge of advanced data structures and distributed computing 
· Good knowledge of SQL for data processing and analysis 
· Good knowledge of Data products and offerings on Google Cloud Platform, and experience with Dataform on GCP would be good to have. 
· Broad knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Java, Go, Python, or Scala), including concepts from functional and object-oriented programming paradigms 
· Broad knowledge of new and emerging tools for extracting, ingesting, and processing of large datasets (Apache Spark, Beam, Kafka, or equivalent) 
· Good knowledge of machine learning or simulation/optimisation models and how they rely on data feeds for their implementation 
· Good knowledge of digital product development principles and the importance of rapid validated learning cycles to optimise performance long term 
· Passionate about the possibilities of Data & Analytics and the value it can generate for the business. 
· Curious world-class problem solver who wants to keep learning! 
This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role. We like to think long term and invest in people’s development together with us. 
The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website: www.ikea.com 
What you'll be doing day to day 
As a Data Engineer, you will be working in a cross-functional team. Here, we are building the global Ingka tool that shows the most important INGKA & Retail KPIs. Specifically, to give management a complete Group performance overview, reducing the need for alternative reports, and facilitating the process of going from facts to insights to actions with clear accountability. Our team works with around 40+ different source systems and hosts close to 70 KPIs in the tool. 
You will be a thought partner on questions like: 
· How should we extract, merge, transform and serve data to enable usage at a global scale? 
· What user needs do we prioritise first, making the optimal trade-off between quick business impact and building for the future? 
· How can we ensure the reliability and quality of the data, and how do we educate team members in cross-functional teams about its importance? 
Perhaps you have your own ideas on problems to solve? We are on a journey to become a data-driven company, and you will have the opportunity to help shape our path based on your knowledge and experience. 
What is our role within IKEA? 
The Data & Analytics function is a core pillar of Group Digital. We are responsible for shaping and driving digital objectives with deep internal competence along the data value chain, ranging from key enablers such as Data Management and Data Architecture to product success drivers like Data Engineering and Advanced Analytics. 
You will work in Data & Analytics together with other Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Data Stewards, and Data Architects. 
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive. To ease our digital growth ambition, we are working in different locations worldwide. The home office for this role will be Malmo, Sweden, but we act as one global team and work together on global solutions. 
We see so many opportunities for what we can do and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about solving business problems, but also about learning and having fun together 
Together as a Team 
· Work on some remarkably interesting problems as described above, and you are encouraged to spot new opportunities or to collaborate with Data & Analytics colleagues in other specialist teams. 
· Opportunities to have a global impact with your work. 
· Flexible and modern tools: we deploy on the Google Cloud Platform, and we use a lot of open-source tools across the board. 
· Hardware and OS of your choice. 
· A team of great colleagues to learn with and from (with world-class experience across all aspects of Data & Analytics). 
· Continuous learning (we aim to spend 20% of our working time on learning). 
· Flexible and friendly working environment. 
· Modern and well-equipped office in our new Digital Hub, located very close to Malmo Hyllie train station, and right opposite to IKEA Malmo store
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

description.text:
What makes Cognizant a unique place to work? The combination of rapid growth and an international and innovative environment! This is creating a lot of opportunities for people like YOU - people with an entrepreneurial spirit who want to make a difference in this world.
At Cognizant, together with your colleagues from all around the world, you will collaborate on creating solutions for the world's leading companies and help them become more flexible, more innovative and successful. And this is your chance to be part of the success story: we are looking for a Data Engineer to join our team in Sweden.
About the team
Cognizant collaborates with all major hyperscale’s and relevant software vendors in the data and AI space. This includes partnerships with industry leaders such as AWS, Microsoft, Google, Snowflake, and Databricks. Our comprehensive approach ensures that we leverage the best tools and technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient solutions. Additionally, we are supported locally by our dedicated Centres of Excellence, which operate both nearshore and offshore. These centres provide specialized expertise and resources, ensuring that we can meet the unique needs of our clients and drive innovation in AI and data cost effectively.


About the Role
The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing data pipelines. Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows and data pipelines to process large datasets efficiently. Design data models, create and maintain views, stored procedures, and other database objects, optimize data storage, and ensure scalability. Implement data governance, access controls, and encryption to protect sensitive information.


Key Responsibilities:
Analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate data from Tdifferent data sources.
Optimize migration processes ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance.
Create and manage objects (tables, views, schemas, stages, procedures).
Implement partitioning, clustering, and performance tuning strategies.
Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and stored procedures in databases.
Monitor and tune database performance, including warehouse sizing and query optimization and ensure efficient resource utilization and cost optimization.
Manage external stages, storage integrations, data security, access controls, and role-based permissions.
Automate data ingestion from various sources connectors and external stages using different file format, code pages, and any integration with Saas tools (e.g. dbt cloud, Fivetran, Databricks etc).
Rewrite and optimize Teradata SQL scripts, macros, and stored procedures for compatibility.
Develop reusable scripts for automation of migration tasks (Python, Shell etc.).
Conduct data reconciliation between different database platforms.
Work closely with data architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements
Document migration processes, best practices, and technical solutions.



Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with cloud data warehouse.
Hands on experience in features like external stages, , storage integration, File Formats, RBAC etc
Strong experience with SQL and various database technologies (Oracle, Teradata SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.).
Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices for data pipelines and workflows.
Experience in data engineering or database development, particularly with data migrations.
Experience in different batch processing and data loading/transformation strategies.
Proficiency in scripting for automating regular or repeating task (python, shell scripting etc).
Understanding of Teradata architecture, SQL, and utilities (BTEQ, FastLoad, MultiLoad, TPT).
Experience in analysing and converting database functions to different platforms.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Snowflake SnowPro Certification is a plus
Experience in banking and financial services will be preferred.



What you can expect
Become part of a ‘flag ship’ success story - We go through enormous growth!
Organization driven by technology – We have a tremendous technology backbone
Environment where you can make your own ideas reality
Drive your own career
Market conforms benefits



The Cognizant community
We are a high caliber team who appreciate and support one another. Our people uphold an energetic, collaborative and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
Cognizant is a global community with more than 300,000+ associates around the world.
We don’t just dream of a better way – we make it happen.
We take care of our people, clients, company, communities and climate by doing what’s right.
We foster an innovative environment where you can build the career path that’s right for you.



About us
Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. Our unique industry-based, consultative approach helps clients envision, build, and run more innovative and efficient businesses. Headquartered in the U.S., Cognizant (a member of the NASDAQ-100 and one of Forbes World’s Best Employers 2024) is consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world. Learn how Cognizant helps clients lead with digital at www.cognizant.com
Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. Your application and candidacy will not be considered based on race, color, sex, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

description.text:
Careium is looking for a Data Engineer to help us shape and build a modern data and delivery platform from the ground up. If you have a strong drive to do things properly and take ownership of your work, then this is the job for you.
About Careium
Careium delivers solutions within personal safety and connected care. We have a global presence but work with a strong local feel, and right now we are in a phase where there is real work to be done - automation, data infrastructure, and smarter ways of building and shipping software are all on the table.
About the Role
As a Data Engineer in the platform team, you will be the driving force behind our data infrastructure. You will work closely with both software developers and the wider organization to ensure that our data is accessible, reliable, and structured for the future.
Day to day you will be working with things like:

Implementing and expanding our central data lake and data warehouse, building upon the completed initial design and its main components.


Setting up and maintaining robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from various internal and external sources.


Continuing the groundwork of our event-driven platform enabling real-time alarm data and user activity.


Moving existing data integrations and legacy data streams onto the new modern platform.


Getting data documentation, a data catalogue, and data governance frameworks in place.


Collaborating with DevOps colleagues in the team to automate data infrastructure deployments and monitoring.


Coaching developers and analysts in data engineering best practices and efficient querying.


Who We Are Looking For
You should have solid hands-on experience from a Data Engineering role and a genuine interest in cloud architecture, data modeling, and streaming data. Since you will be part of a platform team, a DevOps mindset regarding automation, containerization, and infrastructure as code is a big plus.
It helps if you have worked with tools like:

Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent.


AWS, or other cloud providers.


Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.


Streaming and event-hub technologies like Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS Kinesis.


Data transformation and orchestration tools (dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar) as well as modern data warehousing.


Just as important as the technical side, you communicate well, you are easy to work with, and you bring a calm, structured approach when things get complicated. You follow through on what you commit to, and you are not afraid to flag when something is not working.
Practical Information
Location: Malmö Scope: Full-time Work model: Hybrid, as agreed Employment type: 6-month assignment through A-hub. The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Questions about the role are answered by the recruiter responsible.

description.text:
På Knowit Datalytics i Stockholm söker vi en erfaren Data Engineer som vill kombinera tekniskt utvecklingsarbete med förståelse för kundens verksamhet.
Vi erbjuder dig:

Varierande uppdrag hos branschledande kunder med möjlighet att arbeta med modern teknik


En stöttande arbetsmiljö med erfarna kollegor, kunskapsutbyte och goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling


Förmåner som försäkring, pension och årsbonus samt god balans mellan arbete och privatliv


Om rollen
Som Data Engineer arbetar du med att utveckla och förbättra datalösningar hos våra kunder. Uppdragen kan omfatta flera delar av Data & Analytics-kedjan, från strategi och datainsamling till modellering och analys.
Du får bland annat arbeta med:

Utveckling och optimering av automatiserade datapipelines


Datamodellering, datakvalitet och molnbaserade datalösningar inom Azure, AWS och GCP


Samarbete med andra specialister för att möjliggöra avancerad analys och AI-lösningar


Vem är du?
Vi tror att du är en erfaren Data Engineer med god teknisk kompetens inom data och BI. Du trivs med praktiskt utvecklingsarbete och tycker om att hitta lösningar som möter kundens behov.
Vidare ser vi gärna att du har erfarenhet av några av följande tekniker och områden: Azure, Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, SSIS, dbt, Power BI, Python, SQL, PySpark och AI/ML.
Som konsult är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att samarbeta med både kunder och kollegor. Du behärskar svenska och engelska flytande.
Vi ser också positivt på att du är nyfiken på AI och hur tekniken kan bidra till smartare arbetssätt och bättre resultat. Kanske använder du redan AI-verktyg i ditt arbete eller vill utforska möjligheterna tillsammans med oss.
Låter det intressant?
Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi berättar gärna mer om Knowit Datalytics och möjligheterna hos oss.
Om Knowit Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
Vi är cirka 2 100 kollegor i Sverige inklusive Polen med ytterligare 1 500 kollegor i Norge, Finland, Danmark, Tyskland och Serbien.
We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

description.text:
Välkommen till oss
Vill du se dina analysverktyg göra verklig skillnad i stockholmarnas vardag?
Vi söker en Data Warehouse Engineer som tar ansvar för att våra dataflöden är robusta, kvalitetssäkrade och hållbara över tid. Hos oss blir du nyckelpersonen som stabiliserar vår data plattform och säkerställer att rätt information landar rätt – så stadens beslut mer träffsäkra. Vi har datan – nu behöver vi dig som tillsammans med vår nya BI Utvecklare kan bygga strukturen. 
På Stadsmiljöavdelningen arbetar vi med att förvalta och utveckla stadens fysiska miljö. Inom Enheten Analys och stöd fokuserar vi på att stärka kontorets förmåga att fatta datadrivna beslut. Vårt utvecklings- och förvaltningsarbete med digitala plattformar förvaltas inom det som kallas Vintergatan. Genom samverkansområdet DAG (Data Analys GIS) skapar vi en transparent datahantering och ökad tillgång till kvalitetssäkrade datamängder.
Att arbeta här innebär att du får vara med och bygga upp en modern förvaltningsmodell där data blir till värdefulla beslutsunderlag. Du får arbeta i ett tvärfunktionellt team där samverkan mellan IT, analys och verksamhet står i centrum.
Vi erbjuder
Vi har högt ställda ambitioner inom stadens kvalitetsarbete, uppföljning och rapportering och här får du möjlighet att vara med och bidra i centrum av en högt prioriterad fråga. Vi erbjuder dessutom en trygg arbetsplats där vi hjälper och stöttar varandra i det vardagliga arbetet och värnar om den goda arbetsmiljön. Vi har flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet till växling av semesterdagstillägg mot extra ledighet. Vi satsar på medarbetarnas hälsa och erbjuder generös friskvårdsersättning och friskvårdstimme. Arbetsplatsen är centralt belägen i Tekniska nämndhuset på Fleminggatan 4 men också möjlighet att arbeta på distans ett par dagar i veckan. Läs mer om oss:  Trafikkontoret film, Trafikkontorets organisation, Anställningsvillkor och förmåner i Stockholm stad.
Välkommen att växa i en växande stad - där din insats verkligen gör skillnad!
Din roll
Som Datawarehouse Engineer blir du en nyckelperson i arbetet med att etablera en stabil och skalbar förvaltning av våra datamängder. Rollen är en central del av samverkansområdet DAG och utförs inom ramen för Vintergatans förvaltningsmodell, vilket innebär att du arbetar i ett tvärfunktionellt sammanhang som stöttar hela Trafikkontoret.
Ditt uppdrag är att verka enligt principerna i PM 3 (ramverk för förvaltning och styrning) för att säkerställa en strukturerad och transparent datahantering. Du blir bryggan mellan den tekniska lösningen och de verksamheter som använder datat, och ansvarar för att förvaltningsmodellen implementeras i praktiken för att skapa hållbara och kvalitetssäkrade flöden.
Du kommer bland annat att få arbeta med att
Etablera förvaltning: Ta fram rutiner, årshjul och dokumentation som säkerställer en transparent och kvalitetssäkrad datahantering i linje med Vintergatans modell (PM3).
Leda samverkan: Organisera och driva förvaltningsgrupper med representanter från olika avdelningar för att fånga upp behov, förmedla möjligheter och hantera prioriteringar.
Säkerställa datakvalitet: Ansvara för att datalagringen och ETL-processerna (extraktion, transformation och laddning av data) är robusta och tillförlitliga, vilket är förutsättningen för all visualisering och analys.
Förvalta och utveckla: Hantera behörigheter och införande av nya datamängder samt leda det viktiga arbetet med informationsklassning och gallringsutredningar.
Säkra kompetensöverföring: Ta över förvaltningen från externa konsulter och bygga upp intern kompetens och struktur inom organisationen.
Rapportering: Rapportera löpande till produktledare gällande produktplanen.

Din kompetens och erfarenhet
Vi söker dig som trivs i gränssnittet mellan teknik och verksamhet och som har passion för att skapa struktur i komplexa miljöer.
För att lyckas som Datawarehouse engineer, krävs det att du har:
Högskoleexamen inom relevant område (t.ex. systemvetenskap, informatik, statistik eller datavetenskap).
Arbetslivserfarenhet av att designa, bygga och förvalta datamodeller för analys (t.ex. datawarehouse) och dess dataflöden.
Flerårig erfarenhet av att hämta och transformera data ur relationsdatabaser, ex. SQL.
Erfarenhet av att etablera förvaltningsmodeller eller processer för data från grunden.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift. 

Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:
arbete inom offentlig sektor eller stora komplexa organisationer.
geodata, vilket är värdefullt för samverkan inom objektet.
att leda arbetsgrupper eller agera projektledare i förvaltningsnära frågor.

Vi söker dig som tidigare har arbetat i en liknande roll som ex;
Data Warehouse Architect / Data Warehouse Engineer
Data Platform Architect / Data Architect
Data Engineer / ETL Developer / ETL Engineer
Business Intelligence (BI) Developer / Analytics Engineer
Big Data Engineer

Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, innovativ och utvecklingsinriktad, med en djup förståelse för värdet och potentialen i strukturerad data för offentlig förvaltning. Du är en kommunikativ person med en pedagogisk förmåga att omvandla komplexa tekniska lösningar till en begriplig kontext för verksamheten, och du har ett balanserat teknikintresse där verksamhetsnyttan alltid står i centrum.
Vidare har du förmågan att lyfta blicken och se strategiskt och helhetsorienterat kring hela kontorets behov av datastyrning. Du trivs med att växla mellan att arbeta självständigt med analys och att samverka med andra för att driva igenom beslut och leda aktiviteter över organisationsgränser.
Övrigt
Vid bedömningen av din ansökan kommer vi endast att utgå ifrån ditt CV och ett antal frågor du får besvara i samband med att du söker tjänsten. Vi önskar att du svarar konkret och utförligt på frågorna, och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan dina svar och ditt CV. Vänligen skriv ditt CV på svenska.
