  • Review and coordinate data access approvals and stewardship workflows in accordance with governance policies and business ownership responsibilities.


Analytical Solutions

  • Support business stakeholders with complex, non-standard analytical questions that go beyond self-service, applying analytical rigor to validate findings before they inform decisions.
  • Drive adoption of self-service analytics developed with data engineers.
  • Build and maintain complex dashboards and analytical solutions.
  • Validate that self-service and analytical outputs remain accurate when consumed by AI agents, not only by human users.


Data Literacy 

  • Take ownership for growing data literacy within your sub-domain.
  • Train and support business users on self-service analytics solutions


AI-readiness & Ways of Working 

  • Proactively automates routine parts of their own workflow (quality checks, documentation updates, recurring reporting) using agentic AI, and prototypes solutions live with business stakeholders using AI instead of running a traditional multi-week build cycle.


Where you will be

This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.

We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.

With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.

Benefits highlights

  • Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
  • Comprehensive insurance coverage.
  • Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
  • Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
  • Access to in-house sports facilities.


As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

description.text:
Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.
Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and has grown to over 250 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.
Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!
About the role
As a Credit Analyst at Northmill, you will play a key role in finding the right balance between sustainable business growth and responsible risk management. You will work across the entire credit lifecycle, from new customer acquisition and loan origination to portfolio monitoring and collections.
Through data-driven analysis, you will identify opportunities to improve our credit policies, optimise portfolio performance and ensure that our lending strategies remain aligned with Northmill's risk appetite.
This is a hands-on and analytical role where your insights and recommendations will have a direct impact on business decisions. You will work closely with colleagues across Credit Risk, Data Science, Data Engineering, Product and Marketing, translating complex analyses into actionable recommendations.
You will report to the Head of Credit Risk for B2C.
Key responsibilities

Analyse credit performance and identify opportunities to improve Northmill's credit policies and lending strategies.


Continuously monitor lending portfolios throughout the credit lifecycle, identifying trends, deviations and potential risks.


Develop data-driven recommendations and present proposals to the Credit Committee.


Follow up on implemented changes and evaluate their impact on portfolio performance and profitability.


Collaborate with Data Scientists on the development and ongoing improvement of credit models.


Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure data infrastructure and management support effective credit analysis.


Partner with Product and Marketing to balance lending growth, revenue generation and credit risk.


Represent the Credit function in cross-functional projects and drive the implementation of approved initiatives.


Who we are looking for
We are looking for someone with a strong analytical mindset, a genuine curiosity for understanding data and business performance, and the ability to turn insights into meaningful actions.
You are comfortable working independently, taking ownership of your analyses and making recommendations even when information is not always complete. You also enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders and can communicate complex analytical findings in a clear and accessible way.
We believe you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.


Experience as a Credit Analyst, Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.


Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.


Experience working with SQL and Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.


Advanced Excel skills.


Experience using AI tools such as Claude and/or Cursor in your day-to-day analytical work.


Fluency in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.


What we offer

A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views


An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact


Great opportunities for professional development


Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance


Conference abroad every other year


Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday


Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office


Apply today and be a part of Northmill!

description.text:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
We are seeking experienced Lead Data Analysts to drive the data and analytics agenda across one of our Areas within Commercial. In this role, you’ll lead complex, high-impact analytical initiatives and represent data analytics in the wider Commercial domain, from shaping the data roadmap and setting KPIs to delivering production-ready solutions and strategic recommendations that guide key business decisions. You’ll ensure the timely delivery of high-quality work while fostering a collaborative and innovative culture across the team and beyond. 
In addition to the responsibilities above, your role will include: 
Act as a trusted advisor to senior business and product leaders, shaping strategy and priorities through insights on customer behaviour, commercial and product performance. 
Envision, articulate and own a data and analytics roadmap that aligns with organisational goals and future tech trends. 
Lead the KPI-setting work for your area and beyond, ensuring measurement frameworks and event tracking align with and contribute to strategic business goals. 
Lead complex, high-importance analytics projects end to end, from exploratory analysis and proof of concept to A/B testing, productionising, roll-out and scaling, ensuring on-time delivery and high-quality standards. 
Tackle difficult business problems where no good solution exists yet, using advanced methods such as quasi-experiments when a complex roll-out makes standard testing impossible. 
Implement new use cases, including AI: explore large datasets, test new algorithms and prompt engineering approaches, evaluate model outputs and ensure solutions are production-ready and scalable. 
Work closely with solution architects and data engineers on the data architecture and data modelling for your domain, ensuring data quality, accessibility and reliability. 
Stay hands-on with SQL, Python and tools such as BigQuery, dbt, Looker and Power BI to explore, model and visualise data and communicate insights. 
Lead other data analysts on complex projects and mentor colleagues within and beyond your area, championing best practices through demos, documentation and walkthroughs, including coaching on data storytelling. 
Promote a data-driven culture and act as a leader in the analytics Community of Practice within Commercial and across H&M Group, fostering shared learning, collaboration and continuous improvement. 



WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
You’ll join a global, cross-functional team committed to delivering exceptional digital experiences through close collaboration, user-centric design and continuous iteration. As Lead Data Analyst, you’ll represent data analytics for your area and partner closely with other product teams within the global digital experience organisation, data and tech colleagues such as solution architects and data engineers, as well as senior business stakeholders and decision-makers. 


WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with… 
Experience from product or business analysis, customer or commercial analytics, management consulting or data engineering, including leading complex, high-impact analytics initiatives.
Proficiency in SQL and good working experience with Python or R, git, dbt and cloud analytics environments such as GCP or Databricks.
Previous experience within ecommerce, retail, fashion or tech product-driven companies.
Academic degree within Statistics, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering (or similar), or equivalent working experience.
Expertise in data visualisation tools and techniques, e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio.
Strong theoretical and applied knowledge of statistics and expertise in at least one advanced analytics field, such as experimentation, quasi-experiments or backtesting.
Proven ability to independently take a solution from A to Z exploratory analysis, proof of concept, A/B testing, stakeholder alignment, productionising, roll-out and scaling.
Extensive knowledge of data product development and a good understanding of AI, data science and data engineering work.
A proven track record of delivering innovative, impactful data and insights that drive key business decisions at a senior level.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders across different competences (Commercial Leads, eCommerce Managers, Product Managers, Developers, Designers, Data Engineers etc.) in a large matrix organisation.
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to lead and influence decision-making on large, key initiatives.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to foster a positive and collaborative team environment, also outside your own domain.

And people who have… 
Experience working in agile, iterative product development environments.
A proactive, ownership-driven attitude with the ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve conflicts constructively and build alignment across areas and stakeholders.
Curiosity and the drive to spot, explore and test emerging methods and technologies relevant to H&M, and to lead their adoption.
A passion for data advocacy, automation and continuous improvement, always looking for ways to raise data literacy and enhance the team’s ways of working.

 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

Do you want to combine people leadership with hands-on analytical expertise and help strengthen how data and insights support marketing decisions?
We are looking for a Data Analyst Manager to join Marketing Insights & Steering within H&M’s Global Marketing Domain. As our area continues to grow, we are strengthening our leadership capacity to ensure colleagues have the support, clarity and conditions needed to develop and deliver strong business impact.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
This role combines people leadership and hands-on expertise.While you will have formal leadership responsibility, you are also expected to remain an active contributor and role model within your field, helping shape both delivery and capability development across the area.
You’ll lead, coach and develop a team of analysts and specialists while continuing to take ownership of hands-on work within your field. Depending on your experience and the needs of the area, this may include analytical problem-solving, delivery within a product or programme, capability development, stakeholder engagement, improving ways of working or supporting strategic initiatives.
You will:
Lead, coach and develop a team of analysts and specialists
Create clarity around priorities, expectations and development opportunities
Remain hands-on in your field of expertise and take ownership of relevant delivery, analytical work or strategic initiatives
Translate business needs and complex questions into clear analytical approaches, requirements and recommendations
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to strengthen data-informed decision-making
Drive adoption, stakeholder alignment and continuous improvement 
Support recruitment and the continued development of analytical capabilities across the are

  • Support recruitment and the continued development of analytical capabilities across the are

WHO YOU ARE

We believe you have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant experience in analytics, insights, data, business development or a related field
  • Leadership experience through people management or leading others through delivery and change
  • Experience translating business needs into analytical solutions and recommendations
  • Understanding of SQL and Power BI or similar visualisation tools.
  • A strong understanding of data governance, data quality and scalable reporting practices.
  • Strong stakeholder-management, communication and coaching skills
  • Experience working cross-functionally across business and technology
  • The ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery

Additional Information

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Stockholm. As collaboration and teamwork are important to us, we expect an in-office presence of four days per week.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we’re proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer:

  • Global career and development opportunities
  • A value-driven culture where you’re encouraged to be yourself
  • Staff discount cards and benefits
  • Wellness and wellbeing benefits
  • Parental support
  • Opportunities to experiment, grow and create tangible impact in a large-scale organisation

Here, you’re encouraged to be yourself, experiment and grow. As you flourish, so do we.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

description.text:
Nordnet is redefining the landscape of savings and investments, guiding over 2.5 million customers in their financial lives. We have spent the last years building a modern data platform and fostering a culture where actionable insights and rapid product refinement are part of our DNA. In our fast-paced environment, this remains a competitive edge - allowing us to ship, learn, and iterate faster than the market.
Now we are seeking to engage a passionate Data Analyst to join our team.
The role
As a Data Analyst at Nordnet, you will be a part of Data & Insights, where you have the opportunity to work alongside Data analysts, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers.
You will be embedded in our Product development teams, where you will be an integral component, working with designers, product leads and developers. You will deep-dive into our users and our products, and turn data into actionable insights.
We would love it if you feel excited about at least some of these statements.

Going beyond simple questions, defining a problem and understanding the right analytical approach


Conduct statistical analyses on our customer -, financial -, and company data to identify patterns of behaviour


Design experiments to evaluate various hypotheses and design choices


Utilize AI and advanced modeling to scale your impact


Craft and present compelling stories that will impact our decision makers


Help improve our existing methodologies

This is you
You are passionate about data and learning new things, and you want to contribute with your experience and ideas. In your work, you are organised, methodical and agile in a way that benefits the team’s working climate and ability to deliver solutions.
To thrive in this role, we believe that most of these criteria describe you:

Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership


A strong communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Experience of using SQL, Python, R and dbt


Hands-on experience with A/B testing


Degree in economics, data science, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or similar


 We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Analyst at a product oriented organisation.
What we offer
We are committed to your continuous growth, offering a space where you can learn, contribute, and take ownership of your technical domain over time. At Nordnet, we offer:

A hybrid work model balancing remote flexibility with collaboration in our Stockholm office.


5,000 SEK annual wellness contribution (friskvårdsbidrag).


A culture that values continuous learning and technical ownership.


Visit us on www.nordnetab.com,www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.
Application
At Nordnet, we know that the best products are built by teams with a mix of different backgrounds and perspectives. If you are excited about the challenges we’re solving and see yourself contributing to our team culture, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate as part of our standard process for a digital bank.
We look forward to meeting you!

description.text:
About Hotmat.se
Hotmat.se is a growing Swedish food delivery company that partners with restaurants across Sweden. We develop and maintain our own digital platforms and are looking for a Data Analyst to help us understand our business better and make smarter, faster decisions.


Job Description
As a Data Analyst at Hotmat.se, you will be responsible for turning our order, delivery, and customer data into clear insights that support the business. You will work closely with our leadership and development team to build reporting that helps us track performance, spot problems early, and grow more efficiently.


Responsibilities
Analyze order, delivery, and customer data to identify trends and issues
Clean, structure, and prepare data from multiple sources (orders, deliveries, payments, customer feedback) to ensure quality and consistency
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using visualization tools
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract data from our databases
Use Python and pandas for deeper analysis on larger datasets
Present findings in a clear, actionable way to non-technical stakeholders
Collaborate with the development team on data collection and quality


Required Skills
SQL
Python and pandas
Excel
Data cleaning and preparation
Data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or similar)


Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who is:


Passionate about data and turning numbers into decisions
Self-motivated and proactive
Detail-oriented and quality-focused
A strong problem solver
Able to work independently as well as part of a team


What We Offer
Opportunity to shape how a growing company uses data, from the ground up
A growing and innovative company
Flexible working environment
Exciting technical challenges


Location
Gothenburg office


Employment Type
Full-time, permanent position with an initial probationary period.


How to Apply
Please send your CV and, if available, examples of past analysis or dashboards, to jobb@hotmat.se

description.text:
Vill du vara den drivande kraften som omvandlar komplex data till insikter som gör verklig skillnad? Hos oss får du en nyckelroll där din förmåga att visualisera information möter den allra senaste tekniken i Databricks och Microsoft Fabric!

Din roll hos oss

Som Analytics Engineer arbetar du i hjärtat av vår organisation. Du rör dig sömlöst mellan affärens behov och teknikens möjligheter, med Databricks och Microsoft Fabric som din kreativa spelplan för att samla in, bearbeta och väcka data till liv. Det här är rollen för dig som älskar att bygga broar mellan komplexa datamängder, IT och strategiska affärsbeslut.

Vad du tar med dig

Stark förmåga inom datavisualisering: Du är vass på Power BI och semantiska modeller i MS Fabric. För dig handlar det inte bara om att bygga dashboards, utan om att berätta fängslande historier med data som driver engagemang och tydliga insikter.
Erfarenhet av datamodellering & analys: Du förstår affärsprocesserna bakom informationen och är van vid att bygga strukturerade datamodeller utifrån det.
Praktisk programmeringserfarenhet: Du har tidigare arbetat med SQL och Python och ser Databricks som ett bra och naturligt verktyg att använda i din datahantering.
Tydlig kommunikation: Du är trygg i din dialog med olika intressenter. Du har en unik förmåga att hitta den röda tråden i komplexa analysresultat och översätta dem till glasklara beslutsunderlag för ledning och affär.
Helhetssyn på systemdesign: Du har en grundförståelse för infrastruktur, vilket gör dig till en effektiv och uppskattad samarbetspartner för våra teknikteam när vi tillsammans bygger robusta lösningar.


Vem är du?

Genuint nyfiken på affären och hur man bäst omsätter verksamhetens behov till värdeskapande insikter.
En problemlösare som drivs av att hela tiden utvecklas inom moderna data- och analysplattformar.
En person som stortrivs i gränslandet mellan djupdykande modellering och att faktiskt synliggöra värdet för verksamheten genom Power BI-rapporter.
En lagspelare som genom tydlig kommunikation ökar verksamhetens data literacy och skapar en genuin förståelse och passion för data i hela organisationen.
Svenska i tal och skrift är ett krav för denna roll.


Kontaktuppgifter:Rekryterande chef: mathias.sjoberg@lansforsakringar.seFacklig representant Forena: susanne.hirsch2@lansforsakringar.seFacklig representant Akademikerföreningen: maria.eriksson@lansforsakringar.se

Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.

Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.

Affärsenhet Sak är länsförsäkringsgruppens drivkraft inom sakförsäkring. Vi utvecklar nya affärer, skapar smarta försäkringslösningar och ser till att kunderna alltid har trygghet i vardagen. Vi står bakom gemensamma koncept, digital försäljning och kundkommunikation – och vi kompletterar bolagens erbjudanden med specialprodukter som gör skillnad.

Hos oss får du vara med och forma framtidens försäkring – där innovation möter samhällsnytta.

Soros Consulting söker nu en Analytics Engineer till ett konsultuppdrag i Malmö.
Om uppdraget
Uppdraget innebär att utveckla BI-lösningar med Microsoft Fabric för en retailverksamhet som är aktiv på flera marknader, med fokus på styrning (governance) och prestanda. Uppdraget kräver närvaro på plats i Malmö tre dagar i veckan och innebär att dela sin tid mellan två team.
Obligatoriska krav
Expertnivå i DAX, inklusive calculation groups, time intelligence, filterkontext och komplexa mått
 Villighet att bidra till två team (ca 20–30% av tiden i det sekundära teamet)
 Starka SQL-kunskaper samt praktisk erfarenhet av datahantering med PySpark/Spark
 Minst 6 års erfarenhet inom BI, analytics engineering eller data engineering
 Omfattande praktisk erfarenhet av Power BI i en större organisation, inklusive optimering av rapportprestanda, stjärnscheman och semantiska modeller
 Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska
 Praktisk erfarenhet av notebooks, Pipelines, Warehouse och Lakehouse i Microsoft Fabric

Meriterande
Kunskap om retailverksamhet, t.ex. retail-KPI:er, butiks- och produkthierarkier samt POS-data
 Erfarenhet av deployment pipelines, CI/CD och Git
 PL-300- eller DP-600-certifiering

Start: Omgående

Soros Consulting AB tillsätter erfarna specialister inom energi, elkraft, säkerhet och samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Vi matchar rätt kompetens med uppdrag där den gör verklig skillnad. description.text:
Nordic Investin has been asked to find a Senior Analytics Engineer Semantic Models for one of our partner companies. You want technical choices, delivery and production behaviour to reinforce each other, even when the constraints are difficult.
The partner is strengthening its capability in trusted metrics and reusable semantic models for self-service analysis. You will connect SQL, dbt and dimensional modelling while ensuring that semantic layers and testing receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
The environment rewards early questions, visible trade-offs and engineering discipline. Security and operability belong in the design.
How you will work
You will work with product, architecture, security, operations and domain colleagues. The partner values short feedback loops, evidence from real systems and direct communication.
This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for trusted metrics and reusable semantic models for self-service analysis.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for SQL and dbt.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around dimensional modelling.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting semantic layers.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve testing.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through BI governance.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering trusted metrics and reusable semantic models for self-service analysis in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of SQL and dbt.
Practical experience applying dimensional modelling and semantic layers.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving testing.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.
Experience that would add value
Experience from subscription commerce and operational organisations.
Exposure to BI governance in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.
A background that can succeed here
Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of trusted metrics and reusable semantic models for self-service analysis is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.
What makes the opportunity interesting
The role offers meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on trusted metrics and reusable semantic models for self-service analysis gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

The recruitment conversation

Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

description.text:
Analytics Engineer
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time 
The Role:
As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.


Who you are:
A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions.
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more.
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly.
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar.



Qualifications 
We are looking for someone with:
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions).
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines.
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work.
Fluency in written and spoken English (business level).
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design.



Nice to have:
Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on.



What you will do:
You will join the cross-functional data team responsible for Netlight's data platform, enabling decentralized analytics across the organisation. Your key focus areas will be:
Data Modeling & Quality: Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
Governance & Enablement: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
Optimization & Agile Delivery: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.



What we offer:
The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
Mental health & parental support offerings
30 days of paid vacation.



Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
Deutschlandticket
Wellpass



About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.


Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.


Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

31765611.headline: AI Engineer – Python och LLM för ingenjörsverktyg

description.text:
Utveckla AI-drivna lösningar som effektiviserar mjukvaruutveckling och hjälper ingenjörsteam att använda LLM-teknik i praktiken.
Vi söker en erfaren AI Engineer till ett team som utvecklar en plattform för effektivare ingenjörsarbete. Du bygger automatiserade flöden som kombinerar vanlig mjukvaruutveckling med stora språkmodeller och hjälper andra team att använda plattformen i sina tillämpningar.
Uppdraget
Utveckla pipelines som stödjer eller automatiserar ingenjörsuppgifter.
Kombinera mjukvaruautomation, Python och LLM i fungerande lösningar.
Samarbeta med utvecklingsteam kring konfiguration och träning av maskininlärningsplattformen.
Arbeta agilt och visa konkreta resultat för intressenter.

Din kompetens
Masterexamen i data science, datavetenskap, mjukvaruteknik eller liknande.
Stark kompetens inom mjukvaruutveckling och design samt mycket god Pythonprogrammering.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora språkmodeller.
God muntlig och skriftlig engelska.
Samarbetsförmåga, initiativ och vana att leverera till intressenter.

Meriterande
Containerteknik och moln, exempelvis Kubernetes.
DevOps samt fordonsmjukvara eller systemutveckling inom fordonsindustrin.

Uppdragets period och omfattning

2027-01-01 – 2027-06-30. Heltid i Göteborg 1 januari–30 juni 2027. Engelska. Direkt anställning hos leverantören och CV på engelska krävs vid presentation till Volvo.
Ansök senast 2026-11-25.

31760811.headline: Data & AI Engineer to a Fast-Growing Scandinavian Brand!

description.text:
If you're passionate about data, code, and AI, take pride in getting the numbers right, and want to build the data and AI platform behind a fast-growing beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your application today!
About the role
Our client is a Stockholm-based global beauty brand. They develop premium, high-performing products at accessible price points, defined by quality and a Scandinavian aesthetic. Driven by an entrepreneurial and creative culture, they combine modern brand storytelling with operational excellence.
Every decision across their organisation, from which shades to restock to which campaigns to scale or markets to expand into, starts with data. Their modern data platform unifies e-commerce, advertising, and retail metrics, while custom AI assistants empower teams to interact with that data directly.
As a Data & AI Engineer, you will join their Tech team and report directly to the CTO. You will collaborate closely with marketing, finance, and operations to build and run the pipelines, services, and AI tooling powering company-wide analytics. From modelling sales data in Dataform to deploying an MCP server that lets AI assistants query BigQuery, you will ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, documented, and timely figures.
This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or with a couple of years of experience who writes solid SQL, values clean and well-tested code, builds with AI daily, and wants ownership of production systems at a rapidly scaling brand.
Work tasks
You will build and maintain data pipelines, models, and AI-driven services to support business reporting, analytics, and data-informed decisions across the company:
Build and maintain data models in Dataform and BigQuery (incremental models, assertions, and cost-aware partitioning/clustering).  
Ingest data from source systems (e-commerce, advertising platforms, ERP, and retail partners) into BigQuery with scheduling, alerting, and backfills.  
Write and deploy Python or TypeScript services on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) with proper IAM, secrets management, and logging.  
Collaborate with marketing, finance, and operations to translate ambiguous business questions into precise data models and queries.  
Build, deploy, and maintain MCP servers on Cloud Run to connect AI assistants to internal data, applying least-privilege IAM and monitoring.  
Maintain the semantic layer for AI assistants (defining metrics once, writing metadata and catalog documentation, and solving data discrepancies at the source).  
Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as your default development workflow-writing clear task specs, critically reviewing outputs, and shipping tested code via CI/CD.  
Support internal teams in expanding their AI workflows and setting up custom assistants.

We are looking for
A university degree (BSc or MSc) in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, information systems, or an equivalent field. A focus on data science is a strong plus.
2–4 years of experience in big data and data modeling — internships, thesis work, and serious side projects count.
Solid SQL – joins, window functions, data grain and incremental models.
Hands-on coding in Python or TypeScript; you can write, test and debug a small service on your own.
Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud.
An AI-native way of working – you use coding agents daily and know when not to trust their output.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain what you built, and why, to non-technical colleagues.
Curiosity, a quick learning curve and comfort in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent Swedish and English.

It is meritorious if you have
Production experience with BigQuery, and with Dataform or dbt.
Experience with dimensional modelling and data quality testing.
An understanding of containers, service accounts, least-privilege access and basic networking.
Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer brands.
Experience building or integrating LLM-based tooling – MCP, function calling or agents. Side projects count.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stress tolerant
Goal oriented
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

31746491.headline: Frontier Fellow - Forward Deployed AI Engineer

description.text:
The most valuable product development happens where the product meets reality. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work at that intersection: you turn AI agents into production-ready customer solutions and bring what you learn back into the product.
We call this role a Frontier Fellow: part senior engineer, part trusted technical advisor and part bridge between our customers, delivery teams and the HiveAI product team. HiveAI is Fellowmind's agent platform.
About the role
You belong to the HiveAI product organisation, but you will do much of your work alongside our implementation teams and customers.
Building one agent is easy now. Building agents a business can rely on every day is not. That's where you come in: you take on the hardest problems in our customer projects and solve them.
The job doesn't end when the solution works. You turn what you learn into HiveAI: when relevant, functionality, patterns and components built for one customer become reusable capabilities that help the next customer and everyone else.
What you will do
Fix the hard parts. Step in where agents meet real business systems, identity and users, and make them work. When shared components fall short, build your own.
Get AI agents into use, fast. Work with our delivery teams from the first customer conversation to go-live. Put a working first version in front of users within days.
Be a front runner. Help customers and Fellowmind teams make sound architecture decisions, challenge approaches that won't scale and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
Shape HiveAI. Share recurring requirements and architectural insights with the HiveAI development team.
Raise the bar for everyone. Share knowledge, patterns and best practices so implementation teams can deliver HiveAI successfully on their own.

What you might build
An agent that takes over a whole task, like handling supplier invoices or preparing quotes, and asks a person when a decision is needed.
An agent that works across ERP, CRM and the intranet on behalf of the person who asked.
A team of agents that share one business process, handing work to each other.
The tools, MCP servers and integrations they need.

Who are you?
You are an experienced engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the customer.
You can't stop building agents, and you want people to actually use them. You'd rather show something that works than a design document. You make good decisions without all the information, and you're as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code review.
You bring:
Coding agents such as GitHub Copilot as your everyday way of working, and the judgement to know which generated code will hold up in production.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong skills in at least one programming language and solid engineering habits: branches, pull requests and tests
Experience taking software into production, where security, reliability and performance matter.
Practical knowledge of AI models and agents: how they behave, what they cost, how to measure them with evals.
Working knowledge of Azure, Entra ID, On-Behalf-Of and least privilege.
Direct customer-facing experience, from technical discovery and workshops to architecture discussions and communication with senior stakeholders.
A good understanding of modern product development, including when customer-specific functionality should become a reusable product capability.

Nobody ticks every box. If you're strong in several of these and know where to find help for the rest, we'd like to hear from you.
What is HiveAI?
At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It gives enterprises a secure and scalable foundation to move beyond isolated experiments, so AI becomes part of how the business operates.
At its core is the HiveAI Agent Platform, built on Microsoft Azure, which runs AI agents securely and at scale. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, which helps organisations develop, manage and continuously improve their agents over time.
Why Fellowmind?
Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.
Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.
The practicalities
Start: As soon as possible, and of course we'll take your notice period into account.
Scope: Full-time.
Location: This role can be based in Sweden, Denmark or the Netherlands, from one of our Fellowmind offices.
Travel: You will work with regional teams and customers across Fellowmind, so travel is a natural part of the role.
Language: Professional proficiency in English and the local language of your country of employment: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.
Process: We start with a screening interview, followed by in-depth interviews, assessments or case work, and reference checks.

31731168.headline: AI Engineer - Build production AI applications

description.text:
Deerdata is a Stockholm-based consulting firm helping companies succeed with data, analytics, and AI. Our AI practice is growing fast, and we take ideas from strategy through to real, live systems in production.
We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our AI & Agentic team. You’re a strong software engineer at your core, and you’ve shipped AI systems people actually use: agents with real tool access, retrieval and memory layers that hold up against messy customer data, and assistants that face end users without a human babysitting them. You know that a demo is easy and production is hard, and you enjoy closing that gap.
What you’ll do
Design and build customer-facing AI solutions, including agentic systems, GenAI applications, and voice/chat interfaces, from prototype to production
Own the engineering craft: clean, testable code, sensible architecture, CI/CD, observability, cost and latency awareness
Work directly with clients as a trusted technical partner, translating business problems into concrete AI solutions
Support other engineers on the team, and help shape our internal engineering standards and reusable components
Stay ahead of the frontier: evaluate new models, frameworks, and patterns, and bring the right ones into our work

We’re looking for someone who has
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong grounding in Python and modern backend or full-stack development
Hands-on experience building AI-powered products in production, ideally with LLMs, agent frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, ADK or similar), RAG, and vector and graph databases
Comfort with at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern deployment practices (containers, IaC, CI/CD)
A pragmatic mindset: you care about accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and maintainability, not just what looks good in a notebook
Strong communication skills in English, and the confidence to work directly with client stakeholders. Swedish is good to have, and might be required at some of our customer projects

Nice to have
Experience with real-time voice AI
Background in data engineering or MLOps (dbt, Airflow/Dagster, MLflow, evaluation pipelines)
Open-source contributions, technical writing, or speaking at conferences
Experience in a consulting or client-facing setting

What we offer
A seat in a small, sharp team where you’ll build real systems for real users, not slideware
Hybrid way of working
30 days of vacation, occupational pension, and wellness allowance
Curious, kind colleagues who like to roll up their sleeves and co-create

Företagspresentation

Till vår kund, en ledande global aktör inom energibranschen, söker vi nu en AI-ingenjör inom Engineering IT Systems för ett uppdrag på deras site i Finspång. 
Företaget är tack vare högteknologisk och innovativ produktutveckling en etablerad partner inom energisektorn som levererar avancerade samt hållbara lösningar för marknadens nuvarande och framtida behov. 
Du får genom det här uppdraget möjlighet att arbeta i en internationell och framåtsträvande miljö där utvecklingsmöjligheterna är många. 
Det här är inledningsvis ett konsultuppdrag på ca 12 månader via Unik Resurs med mycket god möjlighet till förlängning. 

Vi tillämpar löpande urval vilket innebär att uppdraget kan komma att tillsättas tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum.
Arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden

Som Applied AI Engineer får du en central roll i att omsätta verksamhetens behov till säkra, skalbara och användbara AI-lösningar.
 Du kommer bland annat att:
  Identifiera och analysera AI-användningsområden inom tekniska processer tillsammans med verksamheten och omvandla dem till tekniska krav och lösningsförslag.
 Designa och utveckla tekniska helhetslösningar samt välja lämplig teknikstack, arkitektur och verktyg för respektive användningsområde.
 Välja, anpassa och finjustera AI-modeller, exempelvis Large Language Models (LLM) och klassificeringsmodeller, inklusive dataförberedelse, träning och utvärdering.
 Driftsätta och förvalta AI-modeller och tjänster i Microsoft Azure med fokus på prestanda, säkerhet och kostnadseffektivitet.
 Utveckla och driftsätta MCP-servrar som på ett säkert sätt kopplar samman AI-assistenter och AI-agenter med tekniska system, datakällor och verktyg såsom PLM.
 Bygga och underhålla AI-pipelines, API:er och integrationer samt arbeta enligt MLOps/LLMOps-principer, exempelvis versionshantering, CI/CD, övervakning och hantering av modellernas livscykel.
 Säkerställa att lösningarna följer krav inom data governance, informationssäkerhet och Responsible AI.
 Stötta implementering och kontinuerlig förbättring samt utbilda slutanvändare i AI-verktyg och lösningar.

 Din profil
 
Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för tillämpad AI och som trivs med att kombinera teknisk utveckling med förståelse för verksamhetens behov.
Vi ser gärna att du har:
Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom datavetenskap, data science, engineering eller motsvarande.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python. Erfarenhet av C#/.NET eller TypeScript är meriterande.
Förmåga att snabbt förstå verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar inom exempelvis backend, API:er, databaser, molnplattformar och frontend.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att driftsätta och finjustera AI/ML-modeller och LLM:er, exempelvis med PyTorch, Hugging Face eller liknande ramverk.
Erfarenhet av LLM-baserade lösningar såsom Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI-agenter och verktygsintegrationer.
Erfarenhet av Model Context Protocol (MCP) är starkt meriterande.
God kompetens inom Microsoft Azure, exempelvis Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions/App Service, Docker, AKS samt Azure DevOps eller GitHub.
God förståelse för API:er, relationsdatabaser och SQL.
Erfarenhet av PLM-system och tekniska utvecklingsprocesser är meriterande.
God kommunikativ förmåga och ett kundorienterat arbetssätt. Du trivs med att samarbeta med både tekniska specialister och verksamheten.
Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska är ett krav. Kunskaper i svenska är meriterande.
 
Bli en del av Unik Resurs – Din karriär och utveckling är vår prioritet!

Fast månadslön: Hos oss får du ekonomisk stabilitet med en konkurrenskraftig och pålitlig månadslön.
Trygga anställningsvillkor: Vi följer kollektivavtal och erbjuder förmånliga försäkringar för din trygghet och välbefinnande.

Unikt nätverk: Som en del av Unik Resurs är du aldrig ensam. Du blir en del av ett nätverk av professionella, där samarbete och stöd står i centrum.
Kompetensutveckling genom Unik Academy: Vi investerar i din framtid genom kontinuerlig utbildning och utvecklingsmöjligheter via vår Unik Academy.
Vi välkomnar dig att ta nästa steg i din karriär med oss på Unik Resurs. Ansök idag för att bli en del av vårt engagerade och framåtsträvande team!

31722520.headline: AI Engineer  Automotive Wiring Harness Engineering - 20746 - 1

description.text:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
 Job Overview
Job Description
Overview
Assignment Description
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to develop AI-powered solutions for a wiring harness engineering organization within the automotive industry.
The assignment focuses on designing and implementing AI tools that support engineers working with technical drawings, 3D models, electrical schematics, and engineering documentation.
The initial phase is a 3-month pre-study to understand the engineering environment, available data sources, and existing workflows. The objective is to identify valuable AI use cases, assess technical feasibility, and establish a roadmap for a potential full-scale AI engineering platform.
What You Will Work On
Design, build, and implement AI-powered engineering tools.
Develop solutions for analyzing technical drawings, 3D models, electrical schematics, and engineering documentation.
Support the review and validation of drawings and schematics using AI.
Identify potential design issues, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities.
Assess available data sources, engineering workflows, and technical feasibility.
Identify and validate high-value AI use cases.
Define a roadmap for an AI-powered engineering platform.
Collaborate with engineering and software teams to improve quality, efficiency, and development cycles.

What You Bring
Several years of experience building digital solutions using AI technologies.
Strong background in software development and system integration.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, or related technologies.
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Experience with technical drawings, CAD systems, or product development environments.
Strong communication skills and the ability to bridge engineering and software domains.
Previous experience in the automotive industry.

Meritorious
Experience in wiring harness design and development.
Knowledge of CAD tools such as CATIA, Creo, NX, or similar.
Experience with schematic design tools such as E3, Capital, Zuken, or Saber.
Familiarity with PLM systems and product data management.
Experience with Computer Vision and document intelligence solutions.
Experience developing AI solutions for engineering, manufacturing, or automotive environments.

description.text:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI to join a cross-functional Data & AI team.
The role covers the complete lifecycle of AI solutions, from idea generation and architecture to development, deployment and continuous improvement. You will build solutions using LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, while making technical decisions related to quality, cost, performance and security.
You will also develop robust backend and data solutions to ensure AI applications are scalable, reliable and secure in production.

Design, develop and deploy Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Build RAG solutions, AI agents, prompt engineering and tool-calling capabilities.
Make architectural decisions and evaluate technical trade-offs.
Develop backend services, APIs, data pipelines, databases and system integrations.
Implement deployment processes, CI/CD and observability.
Ensure application performance, scalability, security and data protection.
Work with technologies including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, React.js, FastAPI, Celery, Azure Container Apps, Docker Compose, Azure DevOps and Bicep.

What You Bring
Several years of experience in software and backend development, preferably with Python.
Practical experience with Generative AI and LLM-based solutions, such as RAG or AI agents.
Experience designing technical solutions and making architectural decisions.
Experience with cloud platforms, containerization and CI/CD.
Strong understanding of APIs, databases and distributed systems.
Experience building and deploying production-ready solutions.
Understanding of security, scalability and observability.
Ability to independently drive technical initiatives from problem identification to delivery.

Meritorious
Experience with vector search, embeddings and vector databases.
Experience with agent frameworks and advanced LLM architectures.
Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code, such as Bicep.
MLOps/LLMOps experience.
AI security and guardrails.
Asynchronous programming, such as Celery.
Experience coaching developers or establishing technical practices.
Frontend development knowledge.

description.text:
Uppdragsbeskrivning
För ett tvärfunktionellt spjutspetsteam inom Data & AI i Stockholm söker vi en erfaren Senior AI Engineer. Rollen är central i utvecklingen av organisationens interna enterprise-GPT-plattform (som nyttjas av över 6 000 medarbetare) och innebär ett helhetsansvar från idé, arkitektur och RAG/agentutveckling till driftsättning och MLOps.
I rollen arbetar du över hela livscykeln – från prompt engineering och RAG-arkitekturer till robusta backend-APIs och produktdriftsättning i Azure-miljö.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
Generativ AI & Språkmodeller: Utveckla lösningar baserade på LLM, RAG och agentteknik (prompt engineering, tool calling, agentramverk) samt göra tekniska avvägningar kring kvalitet, kostnad och prestanda.

description.text:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
 Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to develop AI-powered solutions for a wiring harness engineering organization within the automotive industry.
The assignment focuses on designing and implementing AI tools that support engineers working with technical drawings, 3D models, electrical schematics, and engineering documentation.
The initial phase is a 3-month pre-study to understand the engineering environment, available data sources, and existing workflows. The objective is to identify valuable AI use cases, assess technical feasibility, and establish a roadmap for a potential full-scale AI engineering platform.
What You Will Work On
Design, build, and implement AI-powered engineering tools.
Develop solutions for analyzing technical drawings, 3D models, electrical schematics, and engineering documentation.
Support the review and validation of drawings and schematics using AI.
Identify potential design issues, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities.
Assess available data sources, engineering workflows, and technical feasibility.
Identify and validate high-value AI use cases.
Define a roadmap for an AI-powered engineering platform.
Collaborate with engineering and software teams to improve quality, efficiency, and development cycles.

What You Bring
Several years of experience building digital solutions using AI technologies.
Strong background in software development and system integration.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, or related technologies.
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Experience with technical drawings, CAD systems, or product development environments.
Strong communication skills and the ability to bridge engineering and software domains.

Meritorious
Previous experience in the automotive industry.
Experience in wiring harness design and development.
Knowledge of CAD tools such as CATIA, Creo, NX, or similar.
Experience with schematic design tools such as E3, Capital, Zuken, or Saber.
Familiarity with PLM systems and product data management.
Experience with Computer Vision and document intelligence solutions.
Experience developing AI solutions for engineering, manufacturing, or automotive environments.

description.text:
Vill du arbeta med AI-utveckling och skapa smarta lösningar som förenklar människors arbetsvardag? Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av programmering, ett stort intresse för AI och som trivs med att kombinera teknisk problemlösning med samarbete och nya utmaningar.
Om tjänsten:
Som AI Engineer blir du en del av ett AI DevOps-team där du arbetar med att utveckla, underhålla och vidareutveckla AI-agenter och andra AI-baserade lösningar. Med hjälp av Microsofts teknologier får du vara med och skapa verktyg som effektiviserar interna processer och underlättar det dagliga arbetet för organisationens medarbetare.
Du kommer att arbeta nära både tekniska kollegor och interna intressenter för att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dessa till fungerande lösningar. Rollen kombinerar praktisk utveckling med samarbete och kunskapsdelning, där du får möjlighet att bidra med egna idéer, ta initiativ och vara delaktig i att driva arbetet framåt.
Du blir en del av ett team med erfarna kollegor och externa samarbetspartners, där du får möjlighet att fortsätta utveckla din kompetens inom AI och nya tekniker.
Arbetsuppgifter:
Utveckla, testa och vidareutveckla AI-agenter och AI-baserade lösningar.
Programmera, felsöka och underhålla befintliga lösningar.
Arbeta med molntjänster och AI-verktyg, främst inom Microsoft Azure.
Samarbeta med interna intressenter för att förstå behov och ta fram tekniska lösningar.
Bidra till förbättringsarbete, workshops och kunskapsdelning kring AI.

Vi söker dig som:
Har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, datateknik, AI eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.
Har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och programmering, gärna i Python.
Har erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Microsoft Azure.
Har ett intresse för AI och gärna praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla AI-agenter eller andra AI-baserade lösningar.
Har god kommunikativ förmåga och trivs med att samarbeta med andra.

Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med exempelvis Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio eller andra verktyg inom generativ AI.
Som person är du nyfiken, engagerad och tycker om att lära dig nya saker. Du tar gärna egna initiativ, är lösningsorienterad och trivs med att samarbeta med andra. Vi ser positivt på att du är en person som naturligt tar ansvar och tycker om att bidra till att driva arbetet framåt.
Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper, ditt tekniska intresse och din vilja att utvecklas.
Om anställningen:
Detta är ett konsultuppdrag som innebär att du kommer vara anställd hos Friday.
Denna tjänst omfattas av säkerhetsskydd. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. För vissa roller kan krav på svenskt medborgarskap förekomma.
Övrig info:
Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Omgående
Placering: Stockholm
Lön: Marknadsmässig
Rekryteringsansvarig: Axel Stubbing

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen.
Om Friday:
På Friday hjälper vi Tech-talanger att hitta roller där de trivs, utvecklas och gör skillnad. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

description.text:
Vi söker en Project Manager som vill leda förändring där verksamhet, affärssystem och ny teknik möts. För dig handlar projektledning inte bara om planer och deadlines, utan om att förstå vad som behöver förändras och få människor, teknik och beslut att dra åt samma håll.

Du gillar att skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang och röra dig mellan verksamheten och tekniska team. Hos oss kan projekten handla om AI, ERP och affärssystem, integrationer, automation eller andra digitala förändringar.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

leda projekt från förstudie och behovsanalys till implementation och uppföljning
skapa struktur kring mål, scope, plan, budget, risker, beroenden och beslut
leda workshops och hjälpa verksamheten att konkretisera behov och målbild
översätta mellan verksamhet, IT, utvecklingsteam, leverantörer och andra intressenter
arbeta nära tekniska team och förstå hur system, data, processer och integrationer påverkar leveransen
koordinera test, införande, förändring och övergång till förvaltning när det behövs
skapa tydliga beslutsunderlag och kommunicera framdrift, risker och vägval
utmana krav och arbetssätt när det finns ett bättre sätt att nå målet


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet av projektledning, verksamhetsutveckling eller digital transformation och har lett initiativ där verksamhet och IT behöver fungera tillsammans.

Du behöver inte vara SAP-konsult, utvecklare eller AI Engineer. Däremot är du tekniskt nyfiken, kan snabbt sätta dig in i nya systemmiljöer och är bekväm med att arbeta nära både verksamheten och de som bygger lösningen.

Vi tror också att du:

har drivit IT-, system- eller transformationsprojekt från behov till genomförande
är van vid krav, processer, workshops och intressenthantering
förstår grunderna i affärssystem, integrationer och data
kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer och själv ta tag i analys eller krav när det behövs
förstår att införande av ny teknik också handlar om människor, arbetssätt och förändring
har börjat använda AI som ett naturligt verktyg i ditt eget arbete
är tydlig, prestigelös och trygg i dialog med både projektteam och beslutsfattare
driver saker framåt utan att behöva bli detaljstyrd
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ERP- eller affärssystemsprojekt, SAP, AI-initiativ, automation, integrationer, systemimplementationer eller större förändringsprogram.

Konsultbakgrund från projekt inom AI, ERP eller digital transformation är ett plus, särskilt om du är van att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter och skapa förtroende. Det är inget måste.

Det viktiga är inte vilken projektmodell du föredrar eller hur många certifieringar du har. Vi lägger större vikt vid att du kan förstå problemet, skapa förtroende och driva en komplex leverans hela vägen fram.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Som Project Manager får du arbeta nära både tekniken och verksamheten och vara med där idéer blir till lösningar och nya arbetssätt.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

Det viktiga är inte vilken projektmodell du föredrar eller hur många certifieringar du har. Vi lägger större vikt vid att du kan förstå problemet, skapa förtroende och driva en komplex leverans hela vägen fram.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Som Project Manager får du arbeta nära både tekniken och verksamheten och vara med där idéer blir till lösningar och nya arbetssätt.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

description.text:
Vi söker en AI Engineer som vill bygga lösningar som faktiskt används i verksamheten. För dig är AI inte en demo vid sidan av, utan ett verktyg för att lösa riktiga problem, automatisera arbete och skapa bättre sätt att jobba.

Du gillar att bygga, testa och få saker i produktion. Hos oss arbetar du nära både kunden och tekniken och behöver därför vara lika nyfiken på problemet som på modellen, arkitekturen eller verktyget som kan lösa det.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

designa, bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar med generativ AI, LLM:er, agents och automation
koppla AI till affärssystem, dataplattformar, API:er och andra verksamhetskritiska system
välja rätt angreppssätt för exempelvis retrieval, tool use och agentbaserade flöden
ta lösningar från idé och proof of concept till robust implementation och produktion
arbeta med utvärdering, testning, säkerhet, behörigheter och spårbarhet
samarbeta nära kunder för att förstå processer, data och behov och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet inom systemutveckling, data, AI eller liknande och har byggt moderna AI-lösningar i praktiken.

Du behöver inte komma från klassisk machine learning eller forskning. Det viktiga är att du kan bygga fungerande produkter, integrationer och automationer och förstår vad som krävs för att få dem att fungera utanför en demo.

Vi tror också att du:

är en stark utvecklare och känner dig hemma i exempelvis Python, TypeScript, C# eller liknande
har erfarenhet av LLM-baserade lösningar och hur de kopplas till data, verktyg och externa system
är van vid API:er, integrationer och moderna moln- och utvecklingsmiljöer
förstår hur AI kan kopplas till ERP-miljöer som SAP, datalager och andra affärssystem
kan resonera kring säkerhet, behörigheter och dataskydd
är pragmatisk, självgående och bekväm med att välja teknik utifrån problemet snarare än leverantören
kan prata med både verksamheten och tekniska team
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

description.text:
Vill du hjälpa några av Nordens mest spännande organisationer att skapa verkligt affärsvärde med hjälp av AI och data?
 
 
Möjligheten
 
AI & Data är ett snabbt växande och prioriterat område inom EY Technology Consulting. Vi söker en senior konsult med erfarenhet av AI Engineering och modern AI-utveckling som vill hjälpa organisationer att skapa värde med nästa generations AI-lösningar. Hos oss arbetar du med generativ AI, AI-agenter och moderna AI-plattformar, från idé till implementation i produktion.
 
 
Ansvarsområden
 
Som senior konsult inom AI & Data kommer du att:
 
Arbeta i projektroller som AI Engineer, utvecklare, teknisk lead eller lösningsarkitekt
Designa, utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar som skapar affärsvärde hos våra kunder
Utveckla och produktionssätta AI-lösningar och AI-agenter med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och skalbarhet
Arbeta nära kunder för att identifiera användningsområden och omsätta affärsbehov till tekniska lösningar
Samarbeta med kollegor nationellt och globalt för att skapa värde och sprida best practices

 
 
Färdigheter och egenskaper för framgång
 
Vi söker dig som har:
 
2–5 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom AI, AI Engineering, Software Engineering eller liknande
Praktisk erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar och LLM-baserade applikationer i produktionsmiljö
Erfarenhet av moderna AI-teknologier, exempelvis generativ AI, RAG, AI-agenter och agentiska arbetsflöden eller AI-drivna applikationer
Erfarenhet av att ta tekniska lösningar från prototyp eller PoC till produktion
Erfarenhet från konsultbranschen eller liknande
En masterutbildning med goda akademiska meriter eller motsvarande
God kommunikationsförmåga på engelska (svenska är meriterande men inte ett krav)

 
Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet inom följande områden:
 
 
AI Engineering & Modern AI
 
Utvärdering och optimering av AI-system
AI governance, säkerhet och ansvarsfull AI
Konceptuell förståelse för AI-arkitektur

 
 
Plattformar och teknologier
 
Azure AI Foundry och Azure OpenAI
Microsoft Fabric, Databricks eller Snowflake
LangChain, Semantic Kernel eller liknande AI-ramverk
Vector databases och sökteknologier
Azure, AWS eller GCP

 
 
Egenskaper för att lyckas i rollen
 
Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att omsätta ny teknik till affärsvärde. Du trivs i en konsultroll där du kombinerar hands-on teknisk problemlösning med kunddialog. Du är initiativtagande, analytisk och tycker om komplexa utmaningar och att utvecklas tillsammans med engagerade kollegor.
 
 
Vad vi erbjuder dig
 
På EY kommer vi att hjälpa dig utveckla och anpassa dina färdigheter framåt utifrån en upplevelse i världsklass. Vi stärker dig i en flexibel miljö och låter dig och din kompetens blomma i en kultur som värdesätter mångfald och inkludering på en global nivå. Läs mer här Careers at EY | EY - Global.
 
 
Är du redo att “Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag.
 
Vänligen skicka in din ansökan senast den 6 december 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor gällande tjänsten kontakta Fredrik Sannergren på Fredrik.Sannergren@se.ey.com. Vid frågor gällande rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta Adrian Lyng på Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Observera att en bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.
 
På EY främjar vi en inkluderande miljö och värdesätter olikheter. Vi uppmuntrar ansökningar från kandidater med olika bakgrunder och strävar efter en rättvis rekryteringsprocess. Vid behov av stöd eller anpassningar, kontakta vårt rekryteringsteam på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com.
